items.title: 三款都能试玩！网石公开东京电玩展2026参展作活动内容

content.v: 网石于近日公开了参展“东京电玩展2026（TGS 2026）”的参展作《香格里拉边境：七最强种》、《我独自升级：KARMA》、《蓝色珍珠》（Pearl in Blue）的舞台活动阵容。
网石将于17日至21日在日本幕张展览馆举办的TGS 2026上，举行各展出作品的媒体发布会、展示会、Cosplay秀、主播参与的特别舞台等活动。现场可试玩全部3款展出作品。
《香格里拉边境：七最强种》将在TGS 2026首次提供可试玩版本。17日，网石Nexus金京律开发PD和网石日本山下大和事业本部长将在媒体发布会上公开最新信息。Coser ENAKO也将作为特别嘉宾参与。
从18日起，ENAKO和南美海将分别扮演游戏角色，一起每天进行Cosplay秀。还将设置由SHAKA和SPYGEA等主播游玩游戏并挑战讨伐BOSS的特别舞台。网石已于于11日在日本开始了该游戏的预注册。
《我独自升级：KARMA》将于17日举办媒体展示会。网石Neo陈成建开发PD将介绍游戏，演员本乡奏多将参与脱口秀及拍照环节。
20日，饰演成振宇的声优坂泰斗与主播k4sen、Bodoka将进行比拼通关时间的“三方计时攻防战”。Coser伊织萌和Manaso参与的Cosplay秀也将举行。
《蓝色珍珠》将于17日举办由开发团队、日本嘉宾及主要角色声优参与的媒体发布会。网石N2郑贤俊开发PD与日本搞笑组合NON STYLE的井上裕介、自由撰稿人ゲムボク将介绍世界观与角色等。
从18日起，将每天举办由宝泉多惠和菊池由里奈等声优参与的脱口秀，以及东云海和山本诗织等Coser登场的活动。在活动最后一天21日，将举办由VTuber犬山玉姬等参与的“暗夜骑士”绘画舞台。

items.title: 《Diablo 5》总监确认游戏已进入全面开发阶段

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/pyTQNRbucoqiAih.png
虽然暗黑破坏神系列即将迎来大量更新，包括全新的 Netflix 剧集、Diablo 4 Season 15、Switch 2 移植版等，但在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上，该系列最重磅的揭晓莫过于宣布 Diablo V 将于 2029 年推出。
我们采访了这款新作背后的团队，包括游戏总监 Joe Shely、叙事总监 Jennifer Helper 和制作总监 Tiffany Wat。他们为我们提供了大量关于 Diablo 5 的新细节，并透露游戏已经度过了早期开发阶段。
问：我知道可能没有人会错过 Diablo 5 的发布消息，但你们能否从宏观层面介绍一下这款游戏会是什么样子？
Joe Shely： Diablo 5 设定在一个庇护之地已经沦陷、迪亚波罗获胜的世界。这意味着世界正处于末日之中。玩家多年来在其他暗黑破坏神游戏中一直试图阻止的命运最终发生了。其他英雄挺身而出试图阻止迪亚波罗，但都失败了。迪亚波罗坐在威斯特玛的王座上，征服了整个西方大陆。
Diablo 5 设定在 Diablo 4 一百年后的原因
暗黑破坏神4
2.5D, 动作角色扮演, 奇幻, 暗黑系列, 次世代游戏
《暗黑破坏神4：憎恨之躯》更像是一次内容的扩充，而非游戏体验的革新。对于期待《暗黑破坏神4》能够带来更深层次变革的玩家来说，本次收费不菲的资料片不足以满足他们的期待。暴雪像是在尝试通过增加更多同质化的内容来延长游戏的生命周期，同时借此机会实现商业上的收益最大化..

问：Diablo 4 仍有生命力。你们计划在 Diablo 5 中实现哪些你们认为在 Diablo 4 中无法整体实现的目标？

Shely： Diablo 4 拥有光明的支持，团队正在全力维护。我们今天早些时候刚宣布了 Diablo 4 即将推出的内容：亚马逊职业、Season of Hell's legacy，以及登陆 Switch 2，并且我们会持续支持 Diablo 4。玩家有很多理由继续玩下去。当然，我们开发 Diablo 5 已经有一段时间了。我们正处于全面制作阶段，能与玩家分享这个消息对我们来说是非常令人兴奋的时刻。
Jennifer Helper： 我们要让迪亚波罗回归，而迪亚波罗在暗黑系列游戏中绝不应该只是个“顺带一提”的角色。我们需要一个完整的战役和围绕迪亚波罗展开的完整故事。在 Diablo 5 中，我们将时间线跳跃到一百年后，这样在我们开发 Diablo 5 的同时，Diablo 4 也有足够的空间继续他们的故事和发展。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/WVgAnVbucoqiDhn.jpg
Diablo 5 将拥有“前所未见的多样职业”

Tiffany Wat： Diablo 5 是我们真正倾向于一些令人难以置信的创新的机会，无论是在技术上，还是在玩法和系统方面。我们将带来比以往任何一款暗黑破坏神游戏都要多的职业。我们讨论过回归随机生成世界，这在之前的暗黑破坏神游戏中非常受欢迎，我们在 Diablo 4 的地下城系统中也采用了这一点。在 Diablo 5 中，我们深感这是一种非常有趣且不可或缺的玩法，因此我们希望将其带回到大世界和地下城系统中。
Joe 经常向他的团队强调不断探索和未知感的重要性。这为庇护之地世界增添了危险元素，并与 Jennifer 团队尝试讲述的故事完美结合。能够将这一切结合在一起，并实现 Joe 团队的玩法野心，对我们来说开启续作是非常有意义的，而且我们已经为此努力了一段时间。
由于迪亚波罗摧毁了一切，Diablo 5 的开放世界属性将减弱
问：看起来你们更倾向于那种传统的、玩家在不同空间旅行的大世界。所以我们不会有像 Diablo 4 那样的开放世界氛围了？

Wat： 城镇已经不复存在了，因为迪亚波罗和他的恐惧指挥官们已经彻底摧毁了庇护之地。因此，你召集的商队、你遇到的成员、以及随你一起求生的庇护之地幸存者们，你们在不同区域间迁移，试图查明迪亚波罗的情况。这让我们有机会展示在恐惧之王统治下的庇护之地是什么样子的，并看到恐惧指挥官们扭曲世界的不同方式。Joe 和我已经在暗黑破坏神的怪物设计上合作了十多年，天哪，怪物团队正在大展身手。看到你进入的不同世界中，在不同时间出现的那些扭曲、恶心、恐怖的恶魔，真的非常酷。
问：当 Diablo 5 发布时，Diablo 4 和其他游戏的支持似乎仍将继续。当你手头基本上有五款暗黑破坏神游戏在轮换，让玩家每一季都回归时，你是否预见到不仅在留存玩家方面，而且在整体内容创作方面的挑战？
Wat： 我们为每款游戏都设有专门的团队，因为这些游戏对我们和社区都很重要。我认为这给了我们一个很好的合作和交流的机会。尽管我们可能是不同的团队，但我们的合作依然非常紧密，因为最终我们都是在为暗黑破坏神社区制作游戏。我认为现在是成为暗黑破坏神粉丝的最好时机。
Diablo 2 如何启发了 Diablo 5
暗黑破坏神2：重制版
动作, 角色扮演, 奇幻, 暗黑系列, 怀旧
也许是《魔兽争霸3：重制版》的糟糕口碑让暴雪心有余悸，本次的重制相当审慎，能不改的就不改，大改的地方也都相当到位。游戏本身的品质可挑剔处不多，围绕着游戏的最大争议可能就是40刀的售价是否合理了。

问：ARPG 市场正在变大。当目标受众分散在多个作品中时，暗黑破坏神如何在市场中进化？你们会参考这些游戏，看看它们在制作什么新东西来注入到你们的游戏中吗？
Shely： 当然。ARPG 归根结底是系统驱动的游戏。我们会玩所有与暗黑破坏神相关，或者能让我们了解玩家喜好的游戏。但特别的是，我们的方法是专注于暗黑破坏神最核心、最擅长的东西。比如进化我们的战斗模型，制作一款易于上手且拥有精彩战役的游戏。我们希望这能成为我们有史以来最棒的战役。
Diablo 2 的一些硬核要素确实引起了许多核心 ARPG 玩家的共鸣，这也启发了 Diablo 5。例如装备属性需求的回归、物品阶级（这很大程度上受 Diablo 2 启发），甚至还有腰带槽位的回归或背包中的多格物品。
腰带槽位的回归
问：你能具体谈谈腰带槽位的回归，以及 Diablo 5 与 Diablo 4 相比在物品化设计上的不同，以及你们打算如何处理吗？
Shely： 简单的回答是，腰带槽位通常比裤子槽位更令人兴奋。腰带槽位只是我们看待玩家可装备物品组合方式的一种体现。我们总是希望平衡这一点，让你在武器和护甲之间追求适量的不同装备部件。就视觉风格的演变而言，腰带槽位让我们能够制作出胸甲和裤子之间更具整体感的套装。
重返威斯特玛
问：我们看到迪亚波罗现在正回归 Diablo 4，从第 15 赛季开始。在现在到 Diablo 5 发布之间，你们还有很多个赛季。对于迪亚波罗在 Diablo 4 中的实现方式与他在 Diablo 5 中的形象，你们有什么担心的吗？
Helper： 我们不仅将时间线推进了一百年，还回到了西方大陆。Diablo 4 的内容都在东方，而我们回到了威斯特玛，这是每个人在前三部作品中都很熟悉的。威斯特玛已经扩张到了整个西方大陆。所以我们拥有大量西方大陆的未来历史，这是我们很长时间没见过的，我们将能够涵盖这个对我们来说完全开放的空间。
问：最后一个问题。我们什么时候能了解更多关于 Diablo 5 的信息？
Shely： 当我们决定宣布一直在开发 Diablo V 时，我们就想确保分享一些有意义的更新，比如讨论职业、猎魔人和武僧的回归、像瘟疫骑士这样的新职业，以及我们之前谈到的物品化设计。我们希望继续这种对话。特别说明一下，现在谈论这款游戏并将对话持续到 2027 年（届时我们将分享更多信息）的原因，是为了能够与玩家交流，与所有热爱暗黑破坏神的人交流，通过倾听他们的需求来与他们共同构建这款游戏。

items.title: 《Diablo 4》野蛮人《The Witcher 3》杰洛特皮肤公布，但有个前提条件

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/sTQwhvbucomBcwy.png
CD Projekt 和暴雪公布了 Diablo 4 野蛮人的杰洛特主题皮肤首秀，但你需要通过 Battle.net 预购 The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past 才能获得它。
暗黑破坏神4
2.5D, 动作角色扮演, 奇幻, 暗黑系列, 次世代游戏
《暗黑破坏神4：憎恨之躯》更像是一次内容的扩充，而非游戏体验的革新。对于期待《暗黑破坏神4》能够带来更深层次变革的玩家来说，本次收费不菲的资料片不足以满足他们的期待。暴雪像是在尝试通过增加更多同质化的内容来延长游戏的生命周期，同时借此机会实现商业上的收益最大化..
查看更多 立即下载

在 BlizzCon 2026 期间，CD Projekt 的专家社区与社交媒体经理 Amelia Korzycka 和关卡设计主管 Miles Tost 作为嘉宾出席了“Battle.net 30 周年”专题讨论会，揭晓了这款皮肤。该皮肤将提供给在 Battle.net 预购 The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past（目前仅可加入愿望单）或在扩展包发布后购买的玩家。这意味着杰洛特皮肤被锁定在 Battle.net 平台，这也意味着 Steam 等平台的玩家将无法获得。

可以想象，这在那些已在非 Battle.net 平台拥有 The Witcher 3 的 Diablo 4 玩家中引起了不小的争议。The Witcher 3 Remastered 将于 2026 年 9 月 29 日作为免费升级登陆 Steam，面向所有已拥有原版游戏的玩家。因此，那些已经在 Steam 上拥有 The Witcher 3（事到如今谁还没买呢？）并对 The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past 感兴趣的玩家可能会在 Valve 的平台上购买，并且可能不想为了获得 Diablo 4 的杰洛特皮肤而再次在 Battle.net 上购买 The Witcher 3。
“我不会为一个大多数玩家可能早就拥有的 15 年前的游戏再掏一次腰包，”一位玩家在社交媒体上表示。“不过还是谢谢你啊，暴雪。”
“他看起来太糟糕了，”另一位玩家在评论专题讨论会展示的杰洛特面部图像时说道。“但我很高兴，因为我完全不想为了得到这个而在这个有史以来最烂的启动器上预购游戏。我真心希望他们将来能单独出售。”

杰洛特皮肤也遭到了部分 Diablo 4 粉丝的炮轰，因为暴雪昨天确认该作将不再推出后续扩展包。Diablo 游戏总监 Brent Gibson 告诉 PC Gamer：“我们现在的精力都集中在 Diablo 4 赛季和开发 Diablo 5 上。我们觉得已经讲完了《憎恨物语》。我们在墨菲斯托的《憎恨之躯》中得到了一个伟大的结局，现在我们正转向讲述《恐惧物语》。”Diablo 4 于 2023 年 6 月推出，而 Diablo 5 预计将在 2029 年的某个时间点发布。
“对于我们这些创作者来说，这类事情非常有趣，因为它让我们思考，如何让这两个世界以一种既尊重 Diablo 又尊重 The Witcher 原作的方式碰撞出火花？”Tost 在 Battle.net BlizzCon 专题讨论会上谈到杰洛特皮肤时说道。
“所以当我们在审视这类联动时，首先会寻找交集。什么才是合理的？关于 Diablo，在查看职业名单时，我们很快就锁定了野蛮人，认为这里是加入杰洛特启发内容的理想位置。他们都是肉体力量的大师，终其一生都在训练成为超强且有力的近战战士。野蛮人能够同时挥舞多种武器。杰洛特虽然不同时使用，但他确实使用两把剑：标志性的对人钢剑和对怪银剑。”
“你们可以看到——行家一眼就能看出来——这套盔甲深受杰洛特标志性的凯尔莫罕盔甲启发。上面还点缀了一些野蛮人元素……比如那些皮草。我想你们能看到我们是如何尝试以一种对双方团队、世界观以及粉丝都合理的方式来创造这类联动的。我希望你们能感受到我们创造的东西在庇护之地是多么的契合。”
CD Projekt 表示，明年将有更多 The Witcher 主题内容登陆 Diablo 4，更多细节将在稍后公布。“这款将杰洛特风格带入庇护之地地狱景观的皮肤，是 Diablo 4 首个受 The Witcher 启发的内容，更多内容正在制作中，将于 2027 年登陆暴雪的动作 RPG，”CD Projekt 补充道。

与此同时，CD Projekt 宣布，随着与暴雪合作的扩大，赛博朋克2077：往日之影 及其扩展包 赛博朋克2077：往日之影 以及 赛博朋克2077：往日之影 Ultimate Edition 将于今年晚些时候登陆 Battle.net。此外，暴雪的 Overwatch 将在 2027 年推出《赛博朋克：边缘行者》和《边缘行者 2》主题内容。动画续作《边缘行者 2》将于 10 月 20 日在 Netflix 首播。

items.title: 《Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom》评测

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/bPzSdLbucomAEsz.jpg
《小羊肖恩：摩西底的野兽》将于9月18日在院线上映。
在庆祝阿德曼动画成立50周年之际，大多数人会想到《超级无敌掌门狗》系列持续不断的冒险。但这家定格动画工作室更低调的中坚力量一直是小羊肖恩，它最初在1995年获得奥斯卡奖的短片《剃刀边缘》中亮相。此后，它和摩西底农场的羊群出演了多部剧集、短片以及长篇电影三部曲。该三部曲的第三部作品《小羊肖恩：摩西底的野兽》是对环球怪物电影时代的致敬，也是对默片时代视觉喜剧的精彩献礼。

延续了2015年的《小羊肖恩大电影》和2019年的《小羊肖恩：末日农场》，《摩西底的野兽》继续保持其世界观和角色的简洁易懂。这个以万圣节为中心的故事发生在摩西底农场，农场由糊涂的农夫和他那精明但有着夸张地包天牙齿的牧羊犬比泽尔（均由喜剧演员约翰·斯帕克斯配音）管理。留在田野里玩耍的是由极具创意和冒险精神的肖恩（贾斯汀·弗莱彻配音）领导的羊群。羊群意识到农夫通常是个累赘，于是偷偷种下了一片南瓜田，并悉心照料，为了他们的万圣节舞会而将其培育完美，避开了农夫的视线和他那笨手笨脚的双脚。
当然，农夫还是找到了毁掉南瓜田的方法，这促使沮丧的肖恩想出了一个补救办法，好让小羊蒂米和羊群能开上派对。肖恩在谷仓里发现了一本手工制作的科学书，于是化身为“迷你弗兰肯斯坦”——包括在他的风车实验室里进行实验——研制出一种血清，涂在南瓜种子上，让它们能在万圣节前及时长出来。结果南瓜确实长出来了，而且是失控地疯长，这让肖恩不得不反过来去收拾残局。
在电影交织的“B面”剧情中，农夫暗恋着当地的兽医（妮娜·索珊娅饰），但他对日益后移的发际线感到尴尬。当他偶然发现一瓶旧的生发剂（刚被肖恩多余的血清填满）时，他也寻求快速补救，并决定用它来找回自信，约女医生出去。你可以想象接下来的毛发混乱。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/mcTazKbucomBanC.jpg

马克·伯顿和吉尔斯·皮尔布罗剧本的优点，以及大多数肖恩和阿德曼作品的优点在于，电影中日益紧迫的局面并非源于复杂的剧情，而是源于角色行为的升级和多米诺骨牌效应，这构成了简单的叙事。在这里，这意味着年轻观众可以轻松跟上剧情，同时其作为万圣节季节的经典电影基调也能吸引年长观众。此外，编剧和动画师雄心勃勃地在每一帧画面中都填满了恐怖电影的视觉彩蛋、层出不穷的视觉笑料和精彩的角色表现。《摩西底的野兽》几乎没有对话，但效果极佳，因为首次执导长片的导演史蒂夫·考克斯和马修·沃克保持了核心叙事的清晰，并在电影中加入了大量跨代笑料，巧妙地借鉴了当今的恐怖片，以及詹姆斯·鲸的《弗兰肯斯坦》和斯蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格的《大白鲨》中的桥段。

同样值得称赞的是，导演们扩展了农场的范围，延伸到了令人不安的摩西汉姆森林，增加了那个值得作为布景的风车，融入了更多的摩西汉姆镇居民，并包含了一个完整的海上动作序列。这种规模感使得《摩西底的野兽》中的农场不会显得过于狭小，不足以支撑一个电影故事，并继续推向阿德曼动画团队定格动画魔力的极限。说到这里，动画师们超越了自我，在动画作品中加入了大量的动态毛发（当农夫完全变成大脚怪时）；他们还编织了喷溅的水花和水生生物。人们很容易忘记并理所当然地认为，每一个角色和场景都是由动画师手工制作并单独操控的，这使得本作成为该工作室耐心和工艺的又一惊人成就。
人们很容易忘记并理所当然地认为，每一个角色和场景都是由动画师手工制作并单独操控的。
特别要赞扬娜塔莉·霍尔特的配乐，在这部本质上是默片的电影中，配乐承担了巨大的情感重担。她和她的管弦乐队像卡尔·斯塔林在《乐一通》和《梅里小调》中的作曲那样，用华丽的乐章点缀笑点，或者在角色咕哝或胡言乱语之间用音符挖掘情感时刻。
《小羊肖恩：摩西底的野兽》是阿德曼农场三部曲及其更广泛制作史的绝佳补充。它显然是由一群默片时代恐怖电影爱好者和业界最敏捷的俏皮话高手制作的。看到工作室在致敬恐怖类型前辈的同时，继续致力于定格动画技术，这令人感到欣慰。虽然它可能不像《超级无敌掌门狗：复仇狂禽》那样圆滑或高端，但《摩西底的野兽》值得在电影院观看，并有望成为未来的万圣节经典之作。

items.title: Enterprise Esports 允许 MAGNUM 探索转会可能

content.v: Martin "MAGNUM" Penkov 宣布，Enterprise Esports 已允许他在 VCT 2027 season 前寻求其他机会。
“我目前仍有合同在身，也正在与 EP 商谈，但俱乐部已允许我探索其他选择，”他在 X 上写道。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/yBlnTjbucolecui.png
MAGNUM 在 VCT 26: EMEA Stage 2 Play-Ins 获胜后的庆祝瞬间。（图片来源：Riot Games）
MAGNUM 自 2026 年 1 月起便效力于 Enterprise Esports。他在 X 的推文中还表示，愿意前往中国、亚太或北美赛区继续征战，并能够胜任控场位（Controller）或先锋位（Initiator）。
作为一名经验丰富的顶级赛事老将，MAGNUM 的职业生涯曾效力过多支战队，最值得关注的是他曾先后效力于 FNATIC、KOI、Apeks、Karmine Corp 以及 BBL Esports 等知名 VCT 战队。

MAGNUM 在 Enterprise Esports 找到了归属感，在该组织效力了九个月。在此期间，Enterprise Esports 在 EMEA 次级联赛中展现了统治力，接连斩获 VCL 26: EMEA Stage 1、VCL 26: NE Stage 2 以及 VCL 26: EMEA Stage 3 的冠军，并成功拿到了 VCT 26: EMEA Stage 2 Play-Ins 的入场券。
这支捷克战队在 Play-Ins 表现出色，连续赢下三场系列赛，其中包括击败 VCT EMEA 的常客 FNATIC 和 Gentle Mates，成功晋级 VCT EMEA Stage 2 Playoffs。EP 在季后赛初期延续了良好的状态，战胜了 Team Vitality，但随后状态未能保持，先是负于 Karmine Corp，接着在败者组被 Team Liquid 淘汰。
凭借 EP 在 Play-Ins 和季后赛期间展现的上升势头，再加上 MAGNUM 本身深厚的顶级联赛经验，以及 VCT 2027 年的新赛制，MAGNUM 有望重返顶级赛场。

在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上，我们有幸与 Overwatch 的开发团队坐下来聊了聊，讨论了游戏最新的辅助英雄 Doctrine 以及系列的未来——同时也向他们询问了关于猎空作为所谓吉祥物的地位。
当你想到 Overwatch 时，你可能会想到猎空。她在 2016 年游戏首次发布时基本上就是全场焦点，并持续出现在市场宣传、周边、广告等内容中。那时她标志性的剪影和迅捷的技能无处不在……但现在，似乎没那么频繁了。
我们直接询问了 Overwatch 的首席英雄制作人 Kenny Hudson 和艺术总监 Dion Rogers，猎空是否仍然是游戏的吉祥物——或者她是否真的被视为吉祥物。
他们的回答坚定且果断：猎空现在是，而且一直都是 Overwatch 的吉祥物。
“猎空仍然是 Overwatch 的吉祥物。绝对是。‘猎空橙’是团队一直在用的词。徽章顶端的小橙块就是橙色的。她依然是那个女孩，”Rogers 告诉我们。
Overwatch 刚刚迎来了一位全新的辅助英雄 Doctrine，这是一个受吸血鬼启发的角色，与末日铁拳有着深厚的渊源。Rogers 表示，虽然他不是真正的吸血鬼，但这个主题从一开始就是他设计的核心部分。
“这个想法来自我们的首席叙事设计师 Miranda Moyer，她提出了一个问题：‘吸血鬼在 Overwatch 宇宙中会是什么样子？’当我们有一个非常酷的主题可以围绕展开时，我们总能做出最好的英雄，而‘吸血鬼’激发了从技能组、概念到艺术设计的所有灵感，”他解释道。
“这很有趣，因为到了第 54 号英雄，我们已经尝试过牛仔、骑士、忍者等所有原型。一旦我们想到吸血鬼，我们就觉得，‘好，让我们深入研究一下，看看能不能以此创造出一个英雄，’”Hudson 补充道。

“他仍然是一名科学家或机械工程师，甚至他的斗篷感觉也像是他科学身份的一部分……我们最初将他设定为一个科学家，一个典型的家伙，穿着实验袍，戴着眼镜。有时团队在看到一张图像时会说：‘这就是那个英雄。’但他当时还没那种感觉。直到我们采用了 Miranda 提到的吸血鬼元素，将其应用后，他才真正开始像个英雄。你可以看到主题、幻想和原型。让他来自非洲的津巴布韦，赋予了他即时的文化遗产以及与末日铁拳的联系。他曾为末日铁拳的家族工作，并帮助末日铁拳制造了手臂，所以他去联系末日铁拳拿回手臂是合情合理的。”
Doctrine 是今年加入 Overwatch 的 10 个角色中的倒数第二个。随着 2026 年有如此多的内容更新，我们不得不询问 Overwatch 还有哪些高峰需要攀登，以及接下来的计划。
“总会有空间容纳更多英雄，”Rogers 说，“我们还在筹备更多内容。”
“这不仅仅是达到我们已经设定的目标，而是设定新目标并看看我们能走多远，”Hudson 补充道。“我们对团队在过去几年中学到的一切感到非常兴奋，能够真正推向新领域并以新的、有趣的方式进化。”
Doctrine 是今年暴雪嘉年华上展示的几项重大发布之一，而且还有更多内容即将到来；第 55 号英雄也在本周末进行了预热，他是一位看起来非常文雅的智械，粉丝们已经迫不及待想玩了。您可以查阅我们的汇总博文以了解所有公开内容的详细分解，以及我们对 2030 年即将推出的 星际争霸 开放世界射击游戏背后团队的采访。

items.title: 小小魔兽: Forever 开发者解释为何该作让 WoW 2 变得不太可能

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260914/GIMinUbucocrmcC.png
小小魔兽: Forever 是这款长青系列的 Classic+ 迭代版本，它让玩家重返更新后的原版艾泽拉斯，包含新的区域、地下城、团队副本等，该作已在昨天的 BlizzCon 2026 开幕式上正式公布。现在，游戏开发者们正在揭示为什么他们认为这款经典游戏的新版本（以及昨天公布的众多其他 WoW 更新）让传闻已久的 小小魔兽 2 变得不再必要。
在昨天的发布会后，我立即采访了 小小魔兽: Forever 的首席设计师 Kris Zierhut 和首席遭遇战设计师 Mike Nuthals，详细解析了游戏的众多新特性，并探讨了为什么他们认为这比任何潜在的 WoW 续作都要更好。
“我认为 WoW 独特且伟大的一点在于，我们拥有这个在过去 25 年里持续开发的系统、世界和设计，”Zierhut 说道。“而且我们一直在让它变得更好。我们提升了图形效果，改进了渲染和光影；就像我们今天在舞台上展示的那些新东西一样。”
“但我们也让引擎渲染效率变得更高。服务器运行方式、处理玩家及其移动，以及处理法术和战斗的所有环节，多年来都变得更加高效和完善。我们拥有无与伦比的强大引擎和服务器基础设施来驱动游戏。为什么要抛弃这一切从头开始呢？”
Zierhut 接着表示，除了 小小魔兽: Forever 的技术进步外，团队仍致力于构建当前 WoW 宇宙的故事。
“并不是说故事出了什么问题，”Zierhut 说。“我们热爱这个故事。因此，通过 小小魔兽: Forever 回到起点，有机会以全新的、不同的方式探索那个故事。所以很难说，‘有什么是 小小魔兽 2 能给你而 小小魔兽: Forever 还没能给你的？’”
正如昨天在舞台上揭晓的那样，小小魔兽: Forever 不仅仅是原版的翻版更新。除了“更新的世界视觉效果和光影”外，游戏还将包含 10 人和 20 人团队副本、超过 1,000 个新任务、新的种族与职业组合、全新的 Skyborne 种族等。Nuthals 和 Zierhut 表示，有几个关键特性是他们最渴望让粉丝体验到的。
“我非常期待玩家们去发现我们所有的新物品，”Nuthals 说道。“所有的地下城和团队副本都经过了装备属性优化。有这么多新东西值得探索。我非常渴望玩家们进入其中探索世界，寻找那些酷炫的小角落，找到他们心仪的战利品，并度过一段美好的时光。”
“对于我们的团队副本，我最兴奋的是副本规模。我们将拥有 10 人本 Barrow Deeps，20 人本 Hyjal Summit，而 Onyxia 将是 40 人本。我想最让我兴奋的是让大家找到社交群体和朋友来填满这些队伍。”
小小魔兽: Forever 新营地功能详解

“我最兴奋的是营地功能，”Zierhut 说道。“你可能还记得以前在 小小魔兽 中，你可以生起一堆篝火，坐在旁边烹饪食物。现在，烹饪用火变成了基础营火。当你坐在那里等待时（因为你必须在那坐一会儿），另一名玩家经过时可以加入其中。现在你们都在那，必须等待片刻，你可能会问：‘嘿，你在做哪个任务？哦，我们任务一样。嘿，不如组个队？’ 那就是友谊、关系和公会诞生的时刻。我非常期待这会给我们的游戏带来什么变化。”
虽然 小小魔兽: Forever 将包含许多供玩家探索的新更新，但 Zierhut 和 Nuthals 表示，它不会偏离玩家对原版的热爱。
“我们不会对背景故事做大规模改动，”Zierhut 说。“我们不会改变世界的感觉，但我们可能会对发生的事件顺序进行微调。这并不违背 Classic WoW 中的内容，只是稍微有些不同。所以我们为略有不同的故事留出了空间。没人需要担心时间线的问题。”
“我们的支柱非常普世，是玩 Classic WoW 体验的核心，”Nuthals 说道。“这是我们脑海中始终坚持的理念。看到玩家们进入游戏并体验它，这种感觉令人振奋。”
小小魔兽: Forever 将于 11 月 4 日发售。

content.v: 《星际争霸》创意总监兼总经理Dan Hay和开发运营副经理Anna Lee Hertling在接受GameSpot采访时表示，《星际争霸》“将专注于单人游戏”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789265899_899744_jpg_r.jpg
2026暴雪嘉年华最重磅的消息之一便是《星际争霸》的回归，这款游戏被描述为一款开放世界射击游戏，将于2030年发售。除了令人印象深刻的宣传片之外，关于《星际争霸》的玩法以及这款RTS系列射击游戏重启之作的具体内容，官方并没有透露太多信息。
现在，我们掌握了更多细节。当被问及《星际争霸》是单人游戏还是合作游戏时，Hay表示团队“专注于单人游戏”。
“我们目前专注于单人游戏模式的讨论，专注于打造海军陆战队员的幻想世界，然后确保我们思考如何扮演这个角色，这就是我们目前想说的。”
他表示，玩家不会创建自己的角色，而是扮演一个有名字的角色，该角色可以与其他游戏角色“建立声望和关系”。他还说，游戏的故事将有开头、中间和“结尾”，暴雪希望它能给人一种“盒装产品”的感觉。尽管故事会有结局，但Hay表示，暴雪希望这款游戏能够让玩家随时访问、探索、离开，然后再回来继续体验。
“我们喜欢有名字的角色，对吧?”归根结底，我们希望确保塑造的角色是有名字的，是世人都能认识的角色。这样会让故事更有生命力。”

Hay继续说：“你想要做到的是让观众——我必须非常小心，如果我透露太多剧情，Anna Lee肯定会阻止我——但没有什么……我想到了像《死木（Deadwood）》这样的电视剧，它是我最喜欢的五部剧之一。我喜欢的是，剧中所有角色都彼此认识，而且他们都有自己的名声。你走进剧组，他们周二就认识彼此;周四下午3点08分他们也认识彼此，对吧?你想要的是一个有名字的角色，他可以和这些角色建立起名声和默契，让我们感觉他们也是这个世界的一部分。”
Hay在采访中还透露了一些其他信息，包括《星际争霸》将采用第三人称视角而不是第一人称视角，以及暴雪为什么决定提前四年宣布这款游戏。

content.v: World of Warcraft Forever might be stuck in the first year of the MMO for the foreseeable future, but it's going to draw from future iterations of it to freshen up the experience.

Blizzard held a panel at BlizzCon today where WoW Forever developers dug into the crucial design changes that will differentiate it from the WoW Classic we already have. This version of the MMO doesn't sound like it'll be as much of a grind as the OG with its revised classes, talent trees, and all-new mechanics for pulling strangers together in the open world.

Many of the changes seem to fill in the gaps of the original WoW experience so that there's several things to chase as you explore Azeroth. Developers broke down how the MMO will bring players together, how the new "Legacy" progression system works, and how new and old items will influence combat.
Here are the big takeaways from the WoW Forever panel:

There are a lot more details, especially for how popular abilities will work, explained in the panel. Part of the goal, Blizzard said, was to "unsolve" the game and give players a reason to experiment again.

It won't be a long wait to see how it all comes together. WoW Forever will launch on November 4 and will be playable under the same subscription as regular WoW. A beta will go live on Thursday, September 17, which you can access by purchasing the game early.

content.v: 近日虚幻5国产单机ARPG《古神：风里希》公开大量情报。本作定位中式创世神话史诗，是三部曲系列的第一部，计划于2028年发售，登陆PS5、XSX|S和PC(Steam/Epic)平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339981_370768_jpg_r.jpg

《古神：风里希》故事跳出大众熟知的哪吒闹海 剧情 ，回溯洪荒创世时代。玩家扮演女娲以土、水、火所创造的本源生命“灵珠”，从懵懂本源一步步成长，最终化身为哪吒。剧情背景设定在盘古沉眠之后，十日焚天、天柱崩塌的乱世；主角肩负补天、探寻自身起源、封印时空裂隙的使命。主线流程约25小时，内置多重结局。游戏会还原夸父逐日、后羿射日等上古神话名场面，玩家甚至可以攀爬巨神夸父的躯体进行BOSS战，登上扶桑神树完成射日剧情。
战斗系统融合多重经典作品的设计灵感，参考《龙珠》高速突进、《战神3》史诗BOSS战、《街头霸王6》格斗逻辑，实现地面空中无缝衔接的一体化战斗，可以瞬间拉近身位，把敌人击飞后接续空中连段，战斗节奏爽快。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339981_870149.jpg
核心设计理念取自李小龙“Be Water（上善若水）”，也就是水之哲学，将截拳道攻防、弹反反击融入战斗；主角可以凝聚水力释放破甲、范围招式。独有法宝融合系统，能够把后羿神弓、芭蕉扇等上古神器进行组合，生成全新神通。
开发组兼顾硬核与新手体验，支持玩家提前自定义预设连招链，类似街霸现代操作模式，即便是新手也可以打出华丽连段，不会强制要求玩家熟记复杂指令。游戏不追求魂系那种步步谨慎的高压体验，更侧重主动进攻的爽快感，同时保留操作博弈门槛。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339981_115199.jpg
技术层面深度定制虚幻5引擎，实现实时流体水特效、动态昼夜与雷雨冰雹等天气系统、大范围场景破坏。使用MetaHuman高保真面部捕捉。美术参考敦煌石窟雕刻、传统瓷器曲线，打造东方洪荒美学。
制作人Young Lau在采访坦言，《黑神话：悟空》的成功极大提振团队信心，证明中式神话题材可以走向全球。本作规划完整创世神话三部曲，本作仅仅是开篇。团队目前已和PlayStation展开合作，但暂未官宣日语本地化，日本市场是重点目标，希望借游戏实现跨文化玩家交流。

content.v: 游戏是许多人闲暇之余放松的手段之一，玩家在游戏世界里自由自在享乐。不过凡事太过也不好，最近一位美国犹他州的离婚律师Marco Brown表示，在他经手过的离婚案件里，“过度沉迷游戏”是常见导致离婚的主要原因，因为许多丈夫因为顾着玩游戏忽视了其他事情。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339642_146740.jpg
Marco Brown经手超5000件离婚诉讼。近日他在TikTok系列短视频中分享实务见闻，表示电子游戏沉迷已经成为离婚案件当中十分常见的影响因素，相关观点引发玩家热议。
这位律师强调，适度玩游戏本身不会摧毁婚姻，矛盾根源是无节制的长时间游玩带来的现实责任缺失。大量案例显示部分配偶长时间沉浸游戏，把育儿、家务、家庭沟通全部丢给另一半。通宵打游戏，无视伴侣情感需求；还有人因为游戏内氪金消费造成家庭财务受损，日积月累造成夫妻隔阂，最终走向离婚结局。
在他接触的不少案件里，当事人可以连续数小时进行游戏，短暂休息之后立刻重新回到游戏中，完全忽视现实家庭义务。WHO已经将“游戏障碍”列为正式精神诊断，核心特征是对游戏失去控制力、游戏优先级凌驾生活，即便已经造成家庭负面后果依旧持续游玩。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339642_333350_jpg_r.jpg
报道还援引英国过往民间统计，在部分离婚申请中，约有15%的女方将伴侣过度游戏行为列为婚姻破裂的部分诱因，《堡垒之夜》《魔兽世界》《使命召唤》是案例中高频被提及的游戏作品。不过该数据属于民间离婚平台统计，并非严谨学术调研，仅作现象参考，不能代表全部社会情况。
该律师也指出，游戏也可以成为夫妻共同娱乐、增进感情的纽带。关键在于把握边界，平衡游戏爱好和现实家庭责任。不少网友认为婚姻破裂往往是多重矛盾长期积累，游戏很多时候只是浮出水面的表象导火索，而非单一根本原因。

content.v: 最近国产明末武侠类魂动作RPG《一盏秋声：锦衣卫》在2026科隆展放出早期Demo，外媒IGN编辑完成上手体验，将本作战斗氛围类比经典武侠电影《卧虎藏龙》，肯定其武术动作设计，同时点出当前版本仍存在待打磨之处。

《锦衣卫》由成都苍墨信息科技开发，4Divinity发行，计划于2027年登陆PC和PS5平台。游戏故事背景设置在风雨飘摇的明末，主角本是一名神秘船夫，以卧底身份潜入锦衣卫。表面执行朝廷密探任务，暗中图谋推翻锦衣卫组织，整体叙事偏向写实 历史 正剧，弱化玄幻幻想元素。
核心特色“推演”时间回溯机制玩法得到验证：玩家可以消耗资源回溯到过去时间节点，世界状态重置，但玩家身上已经获取的道具、物品全部保留。允许玩家反复试错，例如先拿到通行证，回溯到任务开局，直接凭证件骗过守卫潜入目标地点，实现全程不杀人完成任务，同一箱庭关卡拥有潜行、强攻、智取等多条通关路线。试玩关卡为山间土匪巢穴，即便关卡布局相对朴素，依旧支持高空跃下偷袭、逐个清除巡逻敌人等多样战术选择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339386_131261_jpg_r.jpg

战斗体系以“读招见招拆招”为核心，属于类魂式武侠对战。依靠攻击积攒内力槽，内力既可以紧急回血，也能释放破防武学绝技。战斗途中可无缝切换两把武器，试玩版本提供长剑与弯刀两套兵器。战斗融合大量武侠轻功动作，支持飞檐走壁、壁上奔跑，奔跑过程中可直接发起空中进攻。IGN评价BOSS战是Demo亮点，对手均为武术高手，而非巨型怪物。敌人会释放风刃、追踪飞镖，火焰剑军阀BOSS拥有双阶段变化，十分考验格挡、反击节奏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339386_648832.jpg
评测同时指出现存短板：部分激烈战斗场景存在镜头角度问题，需要后续版本修复；目前开放城镇、大型社区探索内容偏少，期待正式版补充更多开放场景。IGN认为Demo已展现出很高潜力，如果继续打磨，有望在国产武侠动作游戏中留下亮眼表现。

content.v: 近日前V社资深开发者Chet Faliszek表示，运营十余年、持续创收数十亿的《GTAOL》用户粘性极强，R 星想要让大量老玩家迁移至《GTA6》线上模式将会十分艰难。
很少有游戏能够维持长达十余年的运营周期，而《GTAOL》已经持续更新支持超过十年。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789339255_585453_jpg_r.jpg
距离新作发售尚有时日，《GTA6》线上模式已经暗藏隐患，根源就在于《 给他爱5》 线上模式至今依旧热度极高。Faliszek表示《GTA6》线上模式很难把玩家从现有的《GTAOL》生态中转移出来。
这位开发者谈到，过往部分厂商选择直接关停旧游戏，逼迫玩家迁移到新作，但这种做法的成功率并不高。他同时抛出疑问：《GTA6》线上模式，究竟能拿出哪些《给他爱5》线上模式没有的东西，来激励玩家完成迁移？“想要让玩家离开老游戏真的非常困难。GTA6究竟能带给我们哪些给他爱5具备的内容？”

content.v: 此前拳头《英雄联盟》TCG卡牌符文战场 (Riftbound)推出T1 2025全球总决赛冠军纪念签名礼盒，纪念T1拿下队史第五座S赛冠军，限量收藏礼盒流入eBay等二手拍卖平台之后，出现惊人的溢价炒作，在全球卡牌、电竞圈子引发热议。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789338215_355130.jpg
这套T1世界冠军签名限定礼盒（Signature Edition）为多语言限量发行，每个语言版本限量10125套。每套包含五张选手选定主题卡牌，分别对应Doran、Oner、Faker、Gumayusi、Keria，其中随机一张为烫金选手签名卡，卡牌带有1‑2025专属序列号，搭配收藏展示底座与专属包装盒，Faker选择的代表卡牌为英雄加里奥。
礼盒官方定价约数百美元，但是二手市场价格疯狂膨胀。整套礼盒：英文版在eBay二手市场被炒至最高6000美元，中文版、韩文版同样成倍溢价。Faker烫金签名加里奥单卡：尤其是0002这类超低编号藏品，海外卖家挂出15万美元的标价。普通编号Faker签名单卡同样价格高昂，大量收藏家在拍卖页面竞价观望。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789338215_952106_jpg_r.jpg
该卡牌炒作热度已比肩传统体育球星卡市场。部分收藏家愿意为超低序列号、GOAT选手Faker签名付出天价，但也有不少玩家提醒目前大量仅为挂牌标价，不等于真实成交价格。不少人吐槽，原本面向粉丝的纪念周边，已演变为投机炒卖工具。
由于每套礼盒才产出一张随机签名卡，想要开到Faker签名卡本身就只有五分之一概率，再叠加稀有编号，进一步推高单卡的市场心理价位。目前拳头官方没有针对二手炒卖出台限价、管控措施，所有二手交易全部由第三方平台eBay、各地卡牌交易社区自行完成。

content.v: 近日丹麦独立工作室Raw Power Games公布沙盒策略RPG《编年史： 中世纪 》新情报。本作背景设定在 14‑15 世纪英法百年战争时代，可游玩三大势力：英格兰王国、法兰西王国、神圣罗马帝国，计划于2027年初登陆PC开启抢先体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789338038_342580_jpg_r.jpg

《编年史：中世纪》最大特色是无缝双模式战斗系统，并非两套割裂的独立模式。战前玩家可以像《全面战争》一样使用俯视角，布置兵种、规划阵型与行军路线；战斗打响后镜头无缝切至第三人称，玩家亲自扮演指挥官骑马冲锋上阵，此前下达的全部战术指令依旧实时生效，两种视角可以自由来回切换。战斗拥有完整士气机制，击杀敌方将领、成功侧翼包抄能够打崩敌军士气，迫使整支军队溃败，玩家可以下令展开追击；存活下来的部队能够获取经验升级，解锁更强属性与高级阵型指令，单场战役规模最高可达2000单位。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789338038_449836_jpg_r.jpg
游戏拥有覆盖中世纪西欧的巨型沙盒大地图，合计209块独立领地，城堡、纹章大量参考真实历史考据。采用分层战争迷雾机制，已经探索过的区域情报也会过期失效，当玩家前往别处时，世界内部局势会自主发生动态变化；商队、盗匪营地等内容会在世界中动态刷新。开发组强调游戏基础框架高度贴合史实，但创建角色之后，故事走向完全交由玩家，不强制还原真实历史结局，支持改写百年战争走向。
在模拟与RPG机制方面，经济、外交、社会动态全部纳入模拟体系，玩家抉择会对局部乃至整个大陆产生连锁影响。玩家可以一路崛起，建立属于自己的王国，掌控领地与封臣。但本作并非纯粹王国管理模拟器，国家治理大多依靠角色对话、人际互动来完成，而非复杂的数值面板。政治、教会宗教内容都会登场，宗教系统具体实现范围仍在打磨。它不是纯粹中世纪生活模拟器，核心目标是驱动动态故事、保证每一轮游玩体验截然不同。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260914/1789338038_178541_jpg_r.jpg
制作团队透露，EA上线之后还会持续追加新剧情章节。从开发阶段就积极和模组制作者 合作 ，原生支持完善的Mod工具，鼓励社区二次创作。本作没有预设线性主线剧情，全部故事都由玩家的行动催生。团队不少成员参与开发过《巫师3》《赛博朋克2077》《荒野大镖客》等3A大作。

content.v: 《星际争霸》新作不仅会让玩家面对虫族，神族也不会缺席。创意总监丹·海伊（Dan Hay）同时确认，本作将采用第三人称视角，并把单人体验作为重点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789265899_948844_jpg_r.jpg
此前公开的预告片主要围绕人族展开，片中的人族士兵随后遭遇虫族。神族虽然没有直接现身，但海伊暗示，预告片内已经藏有与神族有关的线索，玩家未来也会在游戏中与这一阵营交战。
海伊表示，预告片中某个装置开启并响起号角时，背景里能够看到既不属于人族、也不属于虫族的建筑。相关画面并不显眼，需要仔细观察并稍微调整亮度才能发现。
谈及三个阵营的呈现方式时，海伊没有透露具体剧情或阵营互动机制。他表示，开发团队希望保留各自鲜明的风格：神族古老而神秘，虫族依靠数量与有机力量形成压迫感，人族则带有较为粗放的工业特征。
按照他的构想，玩家面对的敌人与场景不应只有单一风格。游戏既会出现对抗有机生物的时刻，也会让玩家接触代表古老传承的力量。不过，海伊强调自己目前无法公布更多具体内容。
第三人称视角也将改变系列惯常的观察尺度。预告片虽然不一定代表实际玩法，但人族士兵仰望巨大虫族霸主的镜头，已经展示了近距离视角可能带来的体型差异；过去的《星际争霸》作品通常采用等距视角。
海伊还确认，新作将侧重单人体验。目前游戏计划于2030年推出，具体玩法与更多阵营内容尚未公开。

吉布森确认，《暗黑破坏神4》每个赛季发生的故事都是正史的一部分，因此迪卡·凯恩此次回归也会计入系列正式剧情。至于这一安排会把故事引向何处，以及是否与《暗黑破坏神5》产生联系，团队暂未透露。

items.title: Diablo 5 Director Confirms Game is Already in Full Production
items.summary: Diablo 5 is officially in full production and coming in 2029. Game Director Joe Shely reveals the sequel will

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/13/d5-1789336016630.png

While tons of new updates are coming to Diablo, including a new Netflix series , Diablo 4 Season 15, a Switch 2 port , and more, the biggest reveal for the franchise at BlizzCon 2026 was the announcement of Diablo V , coming in 2029.

IGN sat down exclusively with the team behind the upcoming game, including Game Director Joe Shely, Narrative Director Jennifer Helper, and Production Director Tiffany Wat, who gave us tons of new details about Diablo 5, including how it’s already past early development.
IGN: I know probably nobody has missed the Diablo 5 announcement, but can you guys just kind of give sort of a top-level view of what the game will be?

Joe Shely: Diablo 5 is a world where Sanctuary has fallen and Diablo has won. That means that the world is in an apocalypse. The fate that players have been trying to prevent for many years throughout other Diablo games has happened. Other heroes rose up, tried to stop Diablo, and failed. Diablo sits on the throne of Westmarch and has conquered all of the Western continent.
The Reason Diablo 5 is Set 100 Years After Diablo 4
IGN: Diablo 4 still has some life in it. What are you planning to achieve in Diablo 5 that you don't think that as a whole would've been able to be achievable in Diablo 4?

Shely: Diablo 4 has bright support. It's fully supported by the team. We were just announcing earlier today, coming to Diablo 4, the Amazon, the Season of Hell's legacy, Diablo 4 is coming to Switch 2, and there will continue to be ongoing support for Diablo 4. There's many reasons for players to keep playing. And of course, we've been in development for some time on Diablo 5. We're in full production and it's been really an exciting time for us to be able to get to share it with players.

Jennifer Helper: We’re bringing Diablo back and Diablo should never be an “and another thing” in a Diablo game. We need a full campaign and full story based around Diablo. [With Diablo 5], we've jumped a hundred years ahead to tell that story so that Diablo 4 has lots of space to continue their story and their development while we're doing Diablo 5.
Diablo 5 Will Have “More Classes Than You’ve Ever Seen”

Tiffany Wat: [Diablo 5] is an opportunity for us to really lean into some of the incredible innovations, both on the technology, but also on the gameplay and system side. We are bringing more classes than you’ve ever seen in a Diablo game. We talked about bringing back the procedural world, something that was really popular in prior Diablo games, and we leaned into it in Diablo 4 with our dungeon system. In Diablo 5, we really felt that this is such a really fun and integral way to be playing Diablo, and we wanted to bring it back to both the overworld and the dungeon systems.

Joe talks to his team a lot about the importance of constant discovery and not knowing what's around the corner. That adds an element of danger to the world of Sanctuary and that really ties well with the story that Jennifer and her team are trying to tell. Being able to tie all of that together and really reach for the gameplay ambitions that Joe and his team have, it made a lot of sense for us to just embark on a sequel, and we've been doing it for a little bit of time now.
Diablo 5 Will Be Less Open World Because Diablo Has Destroyed Everything
IGN: It seems like you guys are going for more of that traditional overworld that people travel to in different spaces. So we're not going to have that open world vibe like we did in Diablo 4.

Wat: There are no more towns because Diablo and his Dread Commanders have completely destroyed Sanctuary. And so that caravan that you are gathering, these members that you have met, survivors of Sanctuary that are coming along with you to try and just survive, figure out what's going on with Diablo, you're moving from region to region and that gives us a chance to really show what Sanctuary looks like when it's under the Lord of Terror and see the different ways that the Dread Commanders have twisted the world. Joe and I worked together on monsters for over a decade now on Diablo, and man, the monsters team is cooking. So being able to see the twisted, disgusting, horrifying demons that show up at different times in different worlds that you're loading into is just really, really cool.

IGN: When Diablo 5 launches, support seems like it'll continue for Diablo 4 and other games. Do you foresee any challenges with not just player retention, but overall content creation when you have basically five Diablo games in rotation for people to come back to season after season?

Wat: We have dedicated teams for each of those games because those games are important to us and they're really important for our community. I think it really gives us a really great opportunity to be able to collaborate together, to talk with one another. Even though we might be distinct teams, we still work together quite closely because ultimately we are making games for the Diablo community. I think it's the best time to be a Diablo fan.
How Diablo 2 Inspired Diablo 5

IGN: The ARPG market is getting larger. How does Diablo evolve in a market when the target audience is split across multiple titles? Do you look to these games to see what types of new things they're making to inject into your games?

Shely: Of course. ARPGs are ultimately systems games underneath everything. And we play everything that relates to Diablo or could give us an idea of what players are enjoying. But in particular, the way that we approach it is by focusing on the things that are really core to Diablo and Diablo really excels at. Things like evolving our combat model, things like making a game that's approachable and has an incredible campaign. We want this to be our best campaign ever.

Some of the crunchiness of Diablo 2 that really speaks to many of the core ARPG players has inspired Diablo 5 with things like stat requirements returning on items, item tiers, which is very much inspired by Diablo 2, and even things like the return of the belt slot or multi-slot items in your inventory.
The Return of the Belt Slot
IGN: Can you talk a little bit actually about the return of the belt slot and about the itemization in Diablo 5 versus say Diablo 4 and how you guys plan to approach that?

Shely : I mean, the simple answer is that the belt slot is generally a more exciting slot than the pants slot. The belt slot is just a reflection of the way that we look at the suite of items that the player can equip. And we always want to balance that so that you have the right amount of different pieces of your gear that you're chasing both between the weapons and the armor. So in terms of evolving the visual style, one of the things that the belt slot lets us do is make gear sets that are more cohesive between the chest armor and the pants.
A Return to Westmarch

IGN: We see that Diablo is coming back now in Diablo 4, starting with season 15. You've got however many more seasons between now and Diablo 5 launches. Is there anything you're worried about with Diablo’s implementation maybe in Diablo 4 versus how he's going to appear in Diablo 5?

items.title: The Witcher 3 Geralt Skin for Diablo 4 Barbarians Revealed — but There's a Catch
items.summary: CD Projekt and Blizzard have released a first look at the Geralt-themed Barbarian skin for Diablo 4, but you'l

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/13/geralt-1789330423902.png
CD Projekt and Blizzard have released a first look at the Geralt-themed Barbarian skin for Diablo 4 , but you'll need to preorder The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past on Battle.net to get it.

During BlizzCon 2026, CD Projekt’s Expert Community and Social Media Manager Amelia Korzycka and Level Design Lead Miles Tost appeared as guests on the 30 Years of Battle.net panel to reveal the skin, which will be available to Battle.net players who pre-purchase Songs of the Past (it’s only available to wishlist right now), or buy the expansion when it launches. That means the Geralt skin is locked behind Battle.net, which in turn means Steam players, for example, miss out.

This, as you can imagine, isn’t going down particularly well with Diablo 4 players who already own The Witcher 3 on non-Battle.net platforms. Remastered is coming to Steam as a free upgrade on September 29, 2026 for anyone who already owns the base game. So, those who already own The Witcher 3 on Steam (at this point, who doesn't?) and are interested in Songs of the Past are probably going to buy it on Valve's platform, and probably don't want to rebuy The Witcher 3 on Battle.net just so they can get the Geralt skin for Diablo 4.
“Not paying for a second copy of a 15-year-old game that most people who would play it probably already own,” one person said on social media. “Thx though Blizzard.”

“He looks so bad,” another said in response to Geralt’s face in the image shown during the panel itself. “I'm glad tho because I had zero desire to preorder a game in the worst launcher ever just to get this. I really hope they sold it separately in the future.”

The Geralt skin is also coming under fire from some Diablo 4 fans who were angered by Blizzard's confirmation yesterday that the game will not get any further expansions. Diablo game director Brent Gibson told PC Gamer : "We're all focused on [Diablo 4] seasons and getting to Diablo 5. We feel like we told the Story of Hatred. We had a great conclusion with Lord of Hatred with what we have with Mephisto, and we are moving towards telling the Story of Terror." Diablo 4 launched June 2023. Diablo 5 is due out at some point in 2029.

“For us creatively, stuff like this is super fun because it puts us as creatives in a position where we have to think, how do we make these worlds collide in a way that gives respect and pays respect to both of the source materials, Diablo and The Witcher in this context?” Tost said of the Geralt skin during the Battle.net BlizzCon panel.

“So when we look at these kind of things we first try to find the overlap. What makes sense? Diablo of course, talking about classes, looking at the roster, we relatively quickly landed at the Barbarian as the place where we could imagine adding Geralt-inspired content. They’re both masters of physical prowess. They have trained all their lives to become super strong and powerful melee combatants. The Barbarian is capable of wielding multiple weapons at the same time. Geralt doesn’t wield them at the same time, but he does use two swords: the iconic steel for humans and silver for monsters.

“And you can see here — for those of you in the know — that this armor is heavily inspired by Geralt’s iconic Kaer Morhen armor. There’s a bit of Barbarian sprinkled on top… you see all the fur. I think you can see here how we’re trying to create collaborations like these in a way that makes sense for both teams and worlds and also fans. I hope you can see here how we have created something that feels right at home in Sanctuary.”

CD Projekt said that next year even more Witcher-themed content will hit Diablo 4, with more details to be revealed at a later date. “This skin, taking Geralt’s style into the hellscapes of Sanctuary, is the first piece of Witcher-inspired content coming to Diablo 4, and more is in the works, coming to Blizzard’s action-RPG in 2027,” CD Projekt added.

Meanwhile, CD Projekt announced that Cyberpunk 2077 , its expansion Phantom Liberty, and the Ultimate Edition are coming to Battle.net later this year as its partnership with Blizzard expands. Meanwhile, Blizzard’s Overwatch will get Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and Edgerunners 2-themed content in 2027. Sequel animated series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premieres on Netflix on October 20.

items.title: Warcraft 3: Reforged adds always-online requirement, removes LAN mode
items.summary: A bit of a sour note.

content.v: Warcraft 3: Reforged got a hefty 3.0 patch alongside its new Forsaken Kingdom expansion , but not all of the changes are for the better. Amid bugfixes and new features, Reforged now requires an internet connection to play, even in singleplayer, and it also removed the game's local area network (LAN) functionality. Blizzard did not provide a reason for these changes in the patch notes.

Blizzard does mention that LAN support and offline play are still offered by the legacy Warcraft 3 client included with purchase of Reforged. The company has a Battle.net support page with instructions on how to install this legacy client.

But it's still a frustrating, confounding change: Reforged was an embattled remaster that had to claw back support from the fanbase. The Forsaken Kingdom expansion and 3.0 patch were the perfect opportunity to complete a redemption arc and lock in Reforged as the definitive version of the 2002 RTS. But as much as things have improved, it's taken a stumble in its victory lap.

Always-online requirements have been a sore spot in gaming since they first started cropping up in the 2010s, and depending on where you live, reliable high-speed internet isn't always a guarantee. Even in the big city, outages aren't unheard of, and always-online requirements for singleplayer games remain an odious imposition on players.

The LAN removal makes even less sense to me: LAN party and tournament play have always struck me as an essential part of Warcraft 3's legacy. Why concede this ground to the original game when the remaster's reputation has been so contested since its release? You can check out the full Warcraft 3: Reforged patch notes over on the Blizzard forums. More positive changes include a new graphics mode and a doubling of the unit selection cap from 12 to 24.

items.title: You’ll Fight The Protoss In StarCraft, Too, Don’t Worry
items.summary: StarCraft's reveal trailer squarely put the focus on the Terrans, who later in the cinematic face a terrifying

content.v: StarCraft's reveal trailer squarely put the focus on the Terrans, who later in the cinematic face a terrifying confrontation with the Zerg. The franchise's three franchises--including the Protoss--have always been a central element of what distinguishes StarCraft from other strategy games. Although the Protoss were effectively absent from the trailer, they are a foe you will face at some point.

GameSpot spoke with GM and creative director Dan Hay at BlizzCon and asked him about how the three factions will interact with each other. Although he was expectedly coy on specifics, he did offer up some thoughts.

"The answer to that question is I absolutely unequivocally can't say," Hay said. "But what I can do is tell you what I would want as a player. I'll hint at sort of not what we're doing, but some of the things that we think about.

"Of course, what you want to be able to do... you think about the Protoss and how reverent we are. They're older, and there's a mystique and a grandness to them, right? They have just a completely different flavor. Then you have the Zerg, and the Zerg are just numberless; they're infinite from the standpoint of they just overwhelm you with sheer organic power. Then you have the Terrans, that are this group of... they're working their way through the sector in kind of a haphazard and industrial way. We want that feeling.

"We want it to not all just be one taste. So we want to have moments where you're fighting things that are organic, and then moments where you're fighting things that are this wonderful legacy and that are ancient. I want to tell you a lot more, but I can't."
Hay did point out something that was easy to miss in the trailer: a small hint of the Protoss.

"You saw more than the Zerg in the trailer," he said. "If you look a little deeper, there's a moment when the thing opens and you hear that great horn go off. If you look in the background—just in the background, adjust the lighting just a tiny bit—you'll see some architecture that is very not Terran and very not Zerg. It's there."

Hay also confirmed a third-person perspective for StarCraft . While the trailer may not reflect gameplay, it does showcase one way that could impact the feel of the game, as we see the Terran soldier look up in terror at the size of a Zerg Overlord, something you ordinarily only see from an isometric camera view in past StarCraft games.
He also said StarCraft will have a "single-player focus" and offered some insight into why the game was announced now despite arriving in 2030 .

items.title: ‘Hell Yes!’ - Diablo 4 Dev Team Reacts to the Franchise’s New Netflix Show
items.summary: Diablo 4’s lead developers discuss their excitement for the new Diablo Netflix animated series, the game's Swi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/13/diablo-blogroll-1789329136118.png

Among the many announcements during yesterday’s BlizzCon Opening Ceremony, the news that Diablo is getting its own show at Netflix has at least one of the franchise’s development teams chomping at the bit. Yesterday, Blizzard president Johanna Faries revealed that a Diablo animated series is in the works but admitted she “can’t spill the beans” just yet on exactly what the new show entails.

Regardless, the development team behind Diablo 4 says it’s quite possibly the reveal they are most excited about, even more so than the news that Diablo 5 is coming out in 2029 , Diablo 4 is getting a Switch 2 port, Spawn is coming to Diablo Immortal, and the arrival of the Amazon class. I sat down with Brent Gibson, Diablo 4’s Game Director, and Owen Leach, Season Lead for Diablo 4 - Hell’s Legacy, after yesterday’s news to break everything down.

“Even though I have no information and can't share anything, the fact that we're getting a show [is what I’m most excited about]," Gibson says. “I'm a story guy. I want to see more story, as much story as you can get. We’re narrowing in on finding the creative team [for the show] and we're delivering on what Johanna was saying, [that] we're Blizzard Entertainment. I think Diablo's a perfect world to start telling those stories, so I couldn't be more happy that we're getting a show.”

During yesterday’s presentation, Faries also noted that Overwatch, Warcraft and “perhaps even some…other [Blizzard] universes” could get their own series. But for now, news of a Diablo adaptation is proving to be more than enough to keep the development teams buzzing.
“The show is my fan answer [for what I’m most excited about],” Leach says. “I've seen animated shows on Netflix and I'm like, ‘Hell yes.’"

“I think this world of IPs existing and multiple media is the Wild West,” Gibson adds. “You actually can't predict how those mechanisms work. You watch other games that have gotten their shows and how that's plussed things up and changed things. Fallout is a really great example of that. You see this massive resurgence in the game because of the show and I love that. I have no idea where it's going but it's the right time and I'm super excited about it.”
Along with the new Netflix show, Gibson and Leach say there’s plenty for fans to be excited about in the Diablo universe.

“Being the Season Lead of Hell's Legacy, I am so excited for Diablo to be in Diablo 4,” Leach says. “I'm losing my mind and that's just one boss. We’ve got 20 new bosses. Na-Krul from Diablo: Hellfire. I'm sure people in the crowd are going to lose their minds when they find out about that. So September 15th, I can't wait. I'm really excited for players to celebrate the 30th anniversary with us.”
Gibson says that he’s also looking forward to players getting their hands on Diablo 4: Age of Hatred Collection when it launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on September 15.

“It's about damn time,” Gibson says. “We've been talking about what it means to be on handheld platforms since day one. I'm floored at the level of quality they were able to get it to. There is an audience there that we haven't been servicing. I think it was on a list of top 10 games that everybody wanted to have on the Switch 2 from launch. And I'm like, ‘Yeah, me too. Here we go.’ So I'm very happy.”

“I like the flexibility of being able to play wherever I want,” Leach adds. “I used to play on the Steam Deck, but having a specific build for the console is even better. So now I'm playing on my couch because I'm lazy and then some days I'm playing on my PC. That's how we do it.”

items.title: The StarCraft Shooter Is A Third-Person Game, And Blizzard Insists That You Have To Feel “Powerful”
items.summary: If you walked away from the StarCraft reveal excited for the franchise to return, but unsure what this new gam

others.title: StarCraft is a narrative-driven shooter with 'a definitive ending' and 'not a seasonal game'

content.v: If you walked away from the StarCraft reveal excited for the franchise to return, but unsure what this new game even is, you're not alone. Aside from being described during the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony as an open-world shooter, Blizzard didn't share much else. In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard GM Dan Hay provided a few more details, including the fact that it's a third-person game.

The StarCraft franchise, having taken the form of real-time strategy games previously, has typically used an isometric perspective. When it came to choosing what perspective to offer in the new shooter, it sounds like it wasn't a difficult decision.

"Oh, that's easy," Hay said when GameSpot asked him about whether StarCraft will be a first- or third-person game. "I want to be able to see my armor. First thing we did is we built it, put it on a turntable, and spun it around like, 'Ah, awesome, cool!' I want to be able to see it, so third-person, right?

"That doesn't mean that we don't have the license to, in a couple of spaces, do a little bit different and whatnot, but third-person: You get to see your armor, you get to see the full weight of everything you have, and then you get to see stuff that's in my head that I can't tell you."

Hay spoke to us a great deal about the fantasy of having this armor to protect you. Asked about character progression or customization, he said, "If I was to get—in theory, hypothetically, purely hypothetically—this is what I would want: I would want to be able to make sure that my armor can be made better, stronger, and different. I would also want to be able to make sure that I could make it feel like mine. I would want it to be a visitation of the legacy of the things that I had done. I would want to show that it looked different from the first moment that I got it to the last moment I got it. So, read into that how much you will hypothetically, but that's what I would want as a player."

"We have to make sure that we're thinking about—and I have to be careful not to talk about this too much—combat has to feel powerful," he added. "You're in this armor; you're a living tank. You have to feel powerful. When you hold that Gauss rifle, and the thing weighs something ridiculous, you have to feel like you're just pushing through the Zerg. The Zerg have to feel like those raptorial claws are going to shuck you like an oyster in that thing. So you have to feel the weight of all that.

"We take that very seriously. We know that people who are out there are going to be going, 'The teaser was amazing, super cool, the story sounds great, but we want to see that combat. We want to feel those moments. We want to feel the exploration, the sense of discovery, and we also want to feel this notion of disruption—that when I go out into the world, it pushes back in a way that I wasn't expecting, and then I have to figure out a new way to play.' It's how our world works."
Hay also revealed to us that StarCraft is a single-player game (or single-player is at least the focus ) and shared why Blizzard decided to reveal it so soon , given it won't be out until 2030.

items.title: StarCraft Reboot Is “Focusing On Single-Player,” Creative Director Says
items.summary: StarCraft is "focusing on single-player," StarCraft creative director and general manager Dan Hay and associat

content.v: StarCraft is "focusing on single-player," StarCraft creative director and general manager Dan Hay and associate manager of development operations Anna Lee Hertling said in an interview with GameSpot.

One of the biggest announcements of BlizzCon 2026 was the return of StarCraft, described as an open-world shooter and slated for a 2030 release. Aside from its impressive reveal cinematic, there wasn't much additional information about how StarCraft would play or what the shooter reboot of the RTS franchise would entail.
Now, we have some more details. When asked whether StarCraft would be single-player or co-op, Hay said the team is "focusing on single player."

"We are focused right now on the conversation of focusing on single-player, focusing on that Marine fantasy, and then making sure that we think about what it is to be that character," Hay said. "That's what we're saying for now."

He said players will not create their own character but play a named character that can "build a reputation and a rapport" with other in-game characters. He said the game's story will have a beginning, middle, and an "end," and that Blizzard wants it to feel like a "boxed product." Thought it's story will have an end, Hay said Blizzard wants the game to be one players can visit, explore, leave, and come back to.

"We like a named character, right?" Hay said. "When it comes down to this, we want to be able to make sure that what you have is a character that has a name, a character that people in the world can know. What it does it it makes the story have a little bit more life to it."

Hay continued: "What you want to be able to do is have people--and I have to be super careful, Anna Lee will abosultey stop me if I talk too much about the story--but there's nothing...I think about a TV show like Deadwood, which is one of my top five favorites. What I love is the idea that all of those characters know each other and they have a reputation. You go in, and they know each other on a Tuesday; they know each other on a Thursday afternoon at like 3:08, right? What you want is to have a named character that can build a reputation and a rapport with these characters, and that we can have feel like they're part of this world."
Other tidbits shared by Hay during the interview include the fact that StarCraft will be third-person rather than first, as well as why Blizzard decided to announce it now , four years in advance.

items.title: Blizzard Explains Why The StarCraft Shooter Coming In 2030 Was Announced Now
items.summary: Thanks to rumors and reports, the announcement of a new StarCraft game taking the form of an open-world shoote

content.v: Thanks to rumors and reports, the announcement of a new StarCraft game taking the form of an open-world shooter did not come as a complete surprise at BlizzCon's Opening Ceremony . What is surprising is when it's coming: 2030. That's a long time from now, and we've heard other developers lament announcing their games too soon . So what made Blizzard reveal StarCraft so far in advance?

"We totally get the question. You walk that kind of knife's edge of how much do we want to show, when do we want to show," Blizzard GM Dan Hay told GameSpot at BlizzCon. "We've been working on it for a little bit now, and we feel like we've got something that we wanted to show. We felt like this was the right moment. As we're building out the story, the characters, and kind of the feeling of the worlds that we're building, we felt like, 'You know what? We've got enough to show.'"
Hay said that with Blizzard being confident in what it's developed so far, it didn't want to further delay going public and getting the benefit of putting it in front of fans.

"There's a moment when you're making a game where you're like, 'Have we landed the emotion? Do we feel like we have enough of the verve, the identity, and the feel of it to start to share it?'" Hay continued. "About a year ago, we started to feel like we were there, so we were like, 'Okay, it's time to show it. It's time to get feedback.'

"What's super important about it is you want to put it out there, get people to feel the emotion and the value of it, and you want to be there live to be able to get a sense of how they feel about it. We were in the room; it felt great. People were going nuts."

Feedback from fans at this point can only be surface level. Although we know the new game, known at least for now simply as StarCraft, is an open-world shooter, we've yet to see any gameplay--the reveal took the form of an extended cinematic setting up the vibe, but not tipping Blizzard's hand in terms of how it will play. Blizzard confirmed to GameSpot that StarCraft will be a third-person, single-player game, but that's not much to go on.
Still, Hay said he sees value in attaching a date to the project and having developers examine their decision making through that target.

"Yeah, we also know that the date of 2030 is one of those things where--I like a date," Hay said. "I like the idea that there's something out there for us to go after. It helps us sometimes when you get into a meeting and you're thinking about the creative, and you go, 'All right, well how long are we going to wax poetic on this? How long are we going to think about this?' The answer is, 'Can we get all this done by that date?' If the answer is no: Let's rethink, let's refocus, and let's make sure we're thinking about players wanting to get this at the highest level of fidelity possible, but in a reasonable amount of time. That's why we picked that date."

A new StarCraft game that currently feels out of reach isn't a new thing; StarCraft: Ghost infamously was in development for ages but ultimately never came out. Although Hay was not at Blizzard during that era (he spent many years working on the Far Cry franchise at Ubisoft), we asked what Blizzard could take away from Ghost in order to avoid repeating that situation. Although he had little to say about that, he did share more about Blizzard's vision for the new StarCraft.

"I think our focus is we're building a new team. We've got a whole bunch of energy to it from the standpoint of this really comes from what we call a creative ache, right?" Hay said. "We really started with--when you think about the genesis of it--what's the story we want to tell? How do we want to make this game unique and different? The answer is, in previous versions of StarCraft, you were up above, looking down at the battlefield, and you had the deployment of many Marines and many different factions. This time, we were like, 'What if it was just one? What if you only got one suit? What if you had to take care of it?'

"We use the analogy of: You know that first time you get your first car? The first car was probably not great, but it was amazing because it was your first car. What happens when you get this thing and you have to take care of it? What happens when you start to see a world that has opportunity and discovery, but things that you can also pick up and maybe make your armor better? How do you go out into the world and start to take care of this thing and push against it?

"Then you start to think about, 'Wait a minute, I'm in this armor.' You saw it in the teaser: The character in the teaser gets the armor and is feeling super powerful and everything, and it's a 10-foot-tall thing that weighs a thousand pounds. You think, 'There's nothing that I can't beat.' Then you watch his face as the doors open, and you hear that growl of the Zerg. You watch his face--and we spent a ton of time just on the facial expression--of just loss, just the understanding of the distance between what we believe we can do and the reality of what life teaches us. We captured all that in that moment on his face of, 'I might be in trouble here.' But he put up a valiant effort.

"Then you realize: Okay, our story is darker. It's grittier. It's a little bit meaner; it has more stakes and more bite to it. So we thought that that was a great place to start: Put your boots on the ground and say, 'Can you do better than the character in that teaser?'"
Hay also revealed to us that StarCraft is third-person with a single-player focus , and yeah-- you'll fight the Protoss , too.

items.title: World of Warcraft Forever hype dampened by $30 elves: New Skyborne race locked behind expansion-tier purchase
items.summary: Elfflation

content.v: As noted by MMORPG.com , World of Warcraft: Forever is coming with a peculiar economic proposition: Most of the new fork of the MMO is included in your normal WoW subscription (rad), but the new Skyborne Elf race (and its corresponding starter zone experience) is gated behind a separate, $30 purchase (sad).

While "$30 elf" might be a somewhat uncharitable characterization, there's not much else that really lights my fire in the $29.99 "Skyborne Hero Pack." In addition to the titular elves, it comes with a mount, cosmetics, housing decorations, and early name reservation.

Compared to the bleeding edge of Overwatch, League of Legends, and Diablo premium cosmetic pricing, this is just keeping pace. But with many of the best new games on Steam coming in at $20 or less, I'm feeling sticker shock.

$30, for my money, is the cost of an expansion pack under normal economic conditions, though WoW's most recent retailed for $50 MSRP. Speaking to my WoW consultant and on-the-ground BlizzCon contact, PCG contributor Tyler Colp, he wagered that any new classes coming down the line in Forever will likely be similarly monetized, and argued that this sort of monetization is less in the spirit of classic WoW than the rest of the Forever project.

Looking at it from the outside, getting so much of the rest of Forever with a normal WoW subscription strikes me as an excellent bargain, but it only throws the $30 elf into even sharper relief as a consequence. Personally, I'd be more amenable to a $15 elf as a matter of principle, but I've been out of the MMO/live service game for some time. Do you think this is a fair market value for an elf? Sound off in the comments.

items.title: Overwatch Devs Confirm That Yes, Tracer Is Still The Game’s Mascot
items.summary: You heard it here first, folks: Tracer is still the face of Overwatch, despite not being featured in many majo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/13/overwatch-blizzcon-2026-dev-interview-tracer-1789268684009.jpg
You heard it here first, folks: Tracer is still the face of Overwatch , despite not being featured in many major collaborations or promotional materials as of late.

We got the chance to sit down with the minds behind Overwatch at Blizzcon 2026 to discuss the game’s newest support hero, Doctrine , and the future of the franchise — as well as grill them about Tracer’s role as its supposed mascot.

When you think about Overwatch, you probably think of Tracer. She was essentially the star of the show when the game first launched in 2016, and was consistently featured in marketing materials, merchandise, advertisements, and more. Her iconic silhouette and speedy abilities were inescapable back then… but now, not so much.

We directly asked Overwatch’s Lead Hero Producer Kenny Hudson, as well as art director Dion Rogers, if Tracer is still the mascot of the game — or if she was ever really considered its mascot, at all.
Their answer was firm and decisive: Tracer is, and always was, the mascot of Overwatch.

“Tracer is still the mascot for Overwatch. Very much. ‘Tracer orange’ is a quote that the team uses all the time. The little cheeto on top of the sigil is orange. She’s still that girl,” Rogers told us.

Overwatch just got a brand-new support hero in Doctrine, a vampire-inspired character who has a long history with Doomfist. No, he’s not an actual vampire, but that motif was a key part of his design from the very beginning, says Rogers.

“The idea came from our lead narrative designer, Miranda Moyer, who actually asked the question of, ‘What would a vampire look like in the Overwatch universe?’ We always do our best work on heroes when we get a really cool theme to rally around, and ‘vampire’ just got the brain juices flowing on everything from kit, to concept, to art,” he explained.

“This one was fun, because with Hero 54, we’ve hit all the archetypes like cowboy, knight, ninja. Once we thought about the vampire, we were like, ‘Yeah, let’s lean into it and see if we can make a hero out of this,’” Hudson added.

“He’s still a scientist or a mechanical engineer, even his cape still feels like a lab coat from the sciency part of him. …we started him off as a scientist, a typical guy, lab coat, glasses. Sometimes it takes a team saying when they see an image, ‘That’s the hero.’ He didn’t quite feel like it yet. But we took the vampire thing that Miranda mentioned, we applied that, and he actually started to feel like a hero. You can see a theme, you can see a fantasy, you can see an archetype. Making him hail from Zimbabwe, Africa, gives him that immediate heritage and connection to Doomfist. He worked for Doomfist’s family at some point in his life, and helped build arms for Doomfist, so it made sense that he would reach out to him to get his arm back.”

Doctrine is the nearly the last of 10 characters who have come to Overwatch this year. With so much content dropping into the game in 2026, we had to ask about what peaks are left for Overwatch to climb, and what’s in the pipeline next.
“There’s always room for more heroes,” Rogers said. “There’s a lot more we’re cooking.”

“It’s not so much about hitting the targets we’ve already hit, but setting new ones and seeing where we can take it,” Hudson added. “We’re really excited with all the team has learned over the last couple of years to be able to really push ourselves into new territory and evolve in new, interesting ways.”

Doctrine was one of several massive announcements shown off at Blizzcon this year, and there's still more to come; Hero 55 was also teased this weekend, and he's a suave-looking Omnic who fans are already itching to play. You can out our recap blog for full breakdown of everything revealed, as well as our interview with the team behind the upcoming StarCraft open-world shooter coming in 2030.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Devs Explain Why the Game Makes WoW 2 Unlikely
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever developers Kris Zierhut and Mike Nuthals detail the game's new features and explain

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/13/blizzcon2026-blogroll-1789322991703.png

World of Warcraft: Forever, a Classic+ iteration of the long-running franchise that lets players return to an updated vanilla Azeroth featuring new zones, dungeons, raids, and more, was announced at yesterday’s BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony. And now, the game’s developers are revealing why they think the new take on the classic game (along with the numerous other WoW updates announced yesterday) renders the long-speculated World of Warcraft 2 unnecessary. I sat down with Kris Zierhut, World of Warcraft: Forever’s Principal Designer, and Mike Nuthals, the game’s Lead Encounter Designer, immediately following yesterday’s announcement to break down the game’s many new features and to discuss why they think it’s even better than any potential WoW sequel.

“I think one of the things that's singularly great about WoW is we have this game and this world and this design that has been continuously developed for the last 25 years,” Zierhut says. “And we keep making it better. We made the graphics better, we made the rendering better, we made the lighting better; all that new stuff we showed on stage today.

“But we've also made the way the engine draws things move more efficiently. The way the server runs, handling players and moving them around, and all the things that handle spells and combat, all of that's been made more efficient and better over the years. We have this incredible engine and server infrastructure driving the game that is second to none. Why would you throw that away and start over?”
Zierhut went on to say that, in addition to the technical advancements in World of Warcraft: Forever, the team is still invested in building the story of the current WoW universe.

“It’s not like there's something wrong with the story,” Zierhut says. “We love the story. So going back to the beginning [with World of Warcraft: Forever], there's a chance to explore that story in new and different ways. So it's really hard to say, ‘Well, what would a WoW 2 give you that World of Warcraft: Forever isn't already giving you?’”

As revealed on stage yesterday, World of Warcraft: Forever won’t merely be a rehashed update of the original. In addition to “updated world visuals and lighting,” the game will feature 10 and 20-player raids, more than 1,000 new quests, new race and class combos, a new Skyborne race, and more. Nuthals and Zierhut say there are a few key features they’re most eager for fans to experience.

“I'm so excited for our players to uncover all of our new items,” Nuthals says. “All of the dungeons and raids have had an itemization pass. There's so much new to explore. I'm really anxious for our players to get in there and explore the world, find all the cool little nooks and crannies, find their really cool loot and just have a great time.

[And] the thing I think I'm most excited about with our raids are the raid sizes. We're going to have Barrow Deeps which will be our 10-player raid. We're going to have the Hyjal Summit, which will be 20, and then Onyxia will be 40. I think the thing that gets me most excited about that is getting folks to find social groups and friends to fill those groups up.”
World of Warcraft: Forever's New Camping Feature Explained

“The thing I'm most excited about is the camping feature,” Zierhut says. “So you may remember in World of Warcraft in the past, you could put down a cooking fire and you could sit and cook your food. The cooking fire has now become the basic campfire. And while you're sitting there waiting, because you have to sit there for a minute, another player [could walk] by and they add to it. And now you are [all] there and you’ve got to wait a minute you're like, ‘Hey, what quest are you working on? Oh, we’re working on the same quest. Hey, how about we group up?’ And that's the moment the friendships, relationships, and guilds are born. And I'm really excited about what that's going to do for our game.”
While World of Warcraft: Forever will include many new updates for players to explore, Zierhut and Nuthals say it won’t stray too far from what players love about the original.

“We're not going to make massive changes to the lore,” Zierhut says. “We're not going to change the way the world feels, but we can maybe have a slightly different sequence of what's happening. It doesn't contradict what was in Classic, but it's a little bit different. So we have room for a slightly different story. Nobody has to worry about problems with the timeline.”

“Our pillars are very universal, core to the experience of playing Classic WoW,” Nuthals says. “That’s always what we're thinking of in the back of our head. It's exhilarating to see what our players are going to do when they get into it and play it.”
World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4.

items.title: 与传递火炬走向未来的团队讨论《英雄连》20周年
items.summary: “我真的很高兴我们来到这里，能够支持奥运会，并能够庆祝 20 周年。”
items.titleEn: Discussing 20 years of Company of Heroes with the team carrying its torch into the future

content.v: 我还记得 2006 年 10 月的《PC Gamer》封面，其中《英雄连》是“RTS 革命”的先锋。那是在那天，我会步行到当地的杂货店，从报摊上拿起每一期新的实体期刊。我刚满 17 岁，三角学就已经不及格了。在空闲时间，我用从五金店买来的零件制作了万圣节用的光剑刀柄……并试图在我的第一台合适的游戏电脑上让我的空降部队在德国战线后方保持活力。
同年秋天，在温哥华的 Relic Entertainment，一位设计师回忆道，当他们的一款游戏最终获得金牌时，作为仪式的一部分，瓦格纳的《女武神的骑行》在扩音系统中播放。当我今年夏天早些时候访问该团队并与团队讨论该系列的 20 周年纪念时，并没有遇到任何戏剧性的事情，但即使经历了所有的起起落落，我确实发现自己周围的人都对制作一款第二次世界大战 RTS 感到非常兴奋。
不幸的是，该系列最早的许多历史都已随风而逝。有人告诉我，这个想法的起源是一个只有少数人（即使不是整个行业）从 Relic 离开的人还记得的故事。我确实了解到，最初的原型是在 Impossible Creatures 的引擎中创建的，这是一款非常奇怪的 2003 年 RTS，讲述的是创造杂交动物来为你战斗。但《英雄连》的血迹斑斑的袖子确实受到了它的影响，这种影响至今仍然显而易见。
“我们深受《拯救大兵瑞恩》和《兄弟连》的影响，”首席程序员伊恩·汤姆森回忆道。 “在那个时代，视觉质量即将实现巨大飞跃，《半条命 2》中的人物和物理效果让我们大吃一惊。我们希望将其带入以第二次世界大战为背景的即时战略游戏中。”
当然，我还不到可以自己看 R 级电影的年龄，而且当时我还没有看过斯皮尔伯格的史诗片或 HBO 的里程碑式剧集。不过，我对它们的视觉语言非常熟悉，因为我是在《战地 1942》、《荣誉勋章》和原版《使命召唤》中长大的。但即使将那些残酷的诺曼底登陆的视角从第一人称转变为鸟瞰，我记得在战役开始的时刻，戏剧性和恐怖性方面也没有损失多少。
人的因素
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AhtyjMev3FzSEQrxGheGyk.jpg
Relic 将这种让我着迷的现象描述为“人性化战场”，他们认为这是该系列的核心组成部分。在《英雄连》中，音频和动画，甚至在过场动画之外，都让我觉得我指挥的这些小士兵是真实的人，他们希望回到家乡过着生活。他们会寻找掩护。他们士气高昂，如果遭遇猛烈炮火，可能会被压制或逃跑。
《星际争霸》中的普通海军陆战队员基本上都是一个可动人偶。但当我把镜头拉近《英雄连》中的一个步兵小队时，我发现自己在想象：那是来自田纳西州的乔，我可以想象他的猫、他梳妆台上签名的棒球，以及他妈妈为感恩节做的各种馅饼。也许这听起来有点矫情和过度紧张，但他们出售了这种幻觉。
Relic 也正处于世代交替之中，几年前，它几乎完全重塑了 RTS 模式，推出了最初的《战争黎明》。经过多年的《魔兽争霸》、《星际争霸》、《命令与征服》、《帝国时代》，他们抛弃了很多资源采集和基地建设的基本设计，制作了一种新的策略游戏，一切都是关于掩护、势头和领土控制。 《英雄连》感觉更加真实的另一个原因是，它的激励因素导致了真正的战场指挥官可能采用的各种机动和交火。
至于他们是如何做到这一点的，可能只是因为他们敢于不走捷径。
“CoH 团队的显着特征之一是没有人知道如何说不，”首席程序员雷米·萨维尔 (Remy Saville) 回忆道。 “每当有人有一个很酷的想法时，我们都会找到一种方法将其融入其中。掩护系统、可破坏的环境、小队战术，所有这些。结果是一款绝对充满功能的游戏，因为团队不断追求更多功能。”
萨维尔回忆道，当人们停止午休，只是坐在办公桌前玩更多《英雄连》时，显然他们真的知道自己有所作为。然而，同样的极端主义态度可能导致团队陷入麻烦。但就目前而言，情况只是在好转。 《英雄连》以 96 分的成绩成为 PC 玩家历史上评分最高的 RTS，至今仍是我们给出的最高分之一。它获得了两次成功的资料片，分别是 2007 年的《对立前线》和 2009 年的《勇敢传说》。
进入寒冷
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ddZAmB4ap3Ybm9Ww9JEcXW.jpg

在第一款游戏发售后不久，关于续集的讨论就已经开始了。虽然第一章主要关注英国、法国和美国在西线的经历，但下一章似乎很自然地转向东方。对 2013 年的《英雄连 2》来说，等待的时间太长了。等待的时间已经够长了，那个之前三角学不及格的孩子已经到了旧金山，在她曾经每月去商店买的那本杂志实习。我仍然记得第一次在办公室看到 CoH2 的演示，当时它还没有向公众公布。这是一个非常不同的游戏。为了跟上《战争黎明 2》开始的一些模式，它成为了另一部 Relic 续集，经历了一些巨大的、分裂性的波动，而我最终比原作更享受。
遗迹所描绘的东线战场是一片战争景象，它的定义与我们自己制造的铅和钢一样，都是大自然的贡献。步兵在寒冷中呆得太久实际上可能会遭受冻伤。手榴弹可能会炸毁结冰的湖泊和河流，使坦克陷入冰冷的深处。我非常喜欢它。它仍然是该系列中我最喜欢的游戏，我们可能再也不会得到类似的东西了。但它并没有得到普遍接受，尤其是竞技性多人游戏社区。
这让 Relic 陷入了一个尴尬的境地，我见过很多工作室都必须应对这个尴尬的境地。当你发布像《英雄连》这样真正具有标志性和深受喜爱的作品时，后续作品就不能只是千篇一律了。它必须给谈话带来一些新的东西。不可避免的是，并不是每个人都会喜欢这些新事物。曾经将每一个很酷的想法融入到一款游戏中的精神曾引起轰动，但现在它却引起了一波强烈反对。
然而，我们自己的里奇·麦考密克 (Rich McCormick) 在他的评论中写道，他的评分为 80 分，“有时很笨拙，游戏无法维护所有系统，有太多不同的移动部件，无法始终如一地保持连贯性。但最终的结果，尽管一路上有一些小损失，但最终的结果却是胜利者。”

尽管如此，这个故事已经开始在冰中结晶，也许 Relic 已经失去了一点 2000 年代的魔力。 《英雄连 2》很不错，但不如原版，所以你会听到 RTS 爱好者的声音。几年后，随着《战争黎明 3》变得更加令人失望，这开始几乎成为常识。不过，我并不完全相信它。最大的原因是 2014 年发布的一个名为 Ardennes Assault 的小扩展包。游戏发生在旨在模拟突出部战役的动态地图上，您可以在 RTS 小规模冲突之间将部队从一个省调到另一个省，以切断敌人的撤退和增援。我清楚地记得这是《英雄连》系列的巅峰时期。它的配音指挥官拥有丰富的背景故事，反应性的战役人工智能，以及它真正迫使我明智地选择战斗的方式，让我在几年后仍会回想起它。

items.title: 《辐射》开发者蒂姆·凯恩表示，游戏行业的波动性“永远存在”：“现在发生的事情并不新鲜，也不是什么新鲜事”
items.summary: “艺术和技术的不断变化使得整个行业变得不稳定。”
items.titleEn: Fallout dev Tim Cain says the games industry's volatility is 'always gonna be around': 'What's happening now isn't novel, it isn't new'

content.v: 我不知道你是否注意到，游戏行业有点糟糕。尽管（并且正因为）游戏带来了荒谬的金钱，但仍然存在着不合神的整合程度、RAM 末日以及持续不断的大规模裁员浪潮。原版《辐射》的共同创作者蒂姆·凯恩 (Tim Cain) 上周三在 YouTube 上上传了一段视频，解释了为什么他认为当前的事态如此糟糕，甚至令人非常惊讶。
“为什么现在情况看起来特别糟糕？嗯，简单的答案是因为现在情况很糟糕，”他在视频中说道。 “纠正新冠疫情期间的鲁莽投资，硬件成本飙升——很大程度上是由于人工智能数据中心造成的——但投资者正在将资金转移到游戏行业之外，在某些情况下转移到美国之外……事情不得不收缩。这意味着人们将被解雇。
“这些事情都会过去的。他们真的会的。我知道如果你陷入其中，你会想，“这太可怕了。”他们会过去的。这是个好消息。坏消息是，新的事情将会发生。”
凯恩在视频中小心翼翼地澄清，他知道现在的情况非常糟糕，但也表示事情已经很糟糕，而且还会再次糟糕。 “如果你是在过去五年或十年内进入游戏行业的人，并且你认为这将是一份可以持续 30 或 40 年的稳定工作，那么你的假设是错误的。你错了。”
他警告说，以自己数十年的职业生涯作为证据来证明 gamdev 工作对于后起之秀来说是可靠的，这是“幸存者偏差”。他以 1983 年美国本土视频游戏崩溃为例来阐述他的主要观点：“现在发生的事情并不新鲜，对这个行业来说并不新鲜，而且它会一直存在。”至于原因，他认为游戏处于艺术和尖端技术的交叉点，而这两者通常都在迅速变化。

对于无论如何都想适应行业状况的工人，他建议要么磨练不拘一格、广泛的技能，要么高度专业化，成为特定领域的关键人物。值得注意的是，该行业还开展了一场更大规模的劳工权利斗争，试图永久改变其中一些条件：例如，暴雪娱乐的员工刚刚赢得了美国通信工人协会所说的“突破性的第一份合同”，为该工作室的所有游戏开发团队和共享服务提供服务。与此同时，英国独立工人协会目前正在集会支持 Rockstar Games 的员工，因为该公司正在努力应对破坏工会的指控。

items.title: YouTuber 在 Roblox 开发者大会上跑上舞台高喊“我们应该得到更好的”，结果被拦截并被逐出节目
items.summary: 马蒂奥在网上分享了这个特技，并在视频中解释了他的推理。
items.titleEn: YouTuber runs onto the stage at Roblox Developers Conference shouting 'We deserve better,' gets tackled and ejected from show

content.v: 过去几天，Roblox 2026 年开发者大会在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举行，Roblox 首席执行官 David Baszucki 的台上介绍遇到了一些麻烦。 Roblox YouTuber Mathieo 走上舞台高喊“我们值得更好，难道我们不值得更好吗”，同时露出了一件写着“孩子们值得更好”的衬衫，直到他很快被抓住并被护送出去。
哟什么#robloxㅤ pic.twitter.com/ZH3VJNGti0 2026 年 9 月 11 日
Baszucki 当时对这一事件进行了阐述，他说：“正如我们刚才所看到的，当 RDC 出现时，我们都感到有点兴奋。”但它是由 X 用户 bearpuppyrbx 在网上分享的，引发了 Mathieo 本人的转发——“刚刚被踢出了 #rdc26 💔，”他写道。当天，他在上传到他频道的 YouTube 短视频中解释了自己的绝技。
“我知道有很多人真的很喜欢 RDC，我很高兴人们玩得很开心，”他在视频中说道。 “我的问题不在于人。我只是相信 Roblox [公司] 并不像他们所说的那么愚蠢……每个人都说他们不想要人工智能。每个人都说他们不希望这些面孔被弄乱。每个人都希望更好的儿童安全。
“每一个进展缓慢的年份都只是儿童实际受到影响的又一年。”
Roblox 可疑的儿童安全措施多年来一直受到批评。为了解决这一问题，该公司最近推出了儿童账户，美国参议院正在积极调查该平台，欧盟数字服务法案等立法旨在迫使 Roblox 公司保护未成年人。
这款游戏被一家投资公司称为“恋童癖地狱”，Baszucki 过去曾多次将自己的脚放在嘴里——例如，那次他建议 Roblox 成为约会中心，或者他在接受《纽约时报》的灾难性采访时表示，“Roblox 上的掠夺者问题”“不一定只是一个问题，而且也是一个机会”。
马蒂奥在视频中说：“我们发现告诉他们是行不通的。” “多年来，这个问题一直是一个非常普遍的问题。虽然他们正在‘寻找解决方案’，但最近可能有很多孩子在 Roblox 上受到伤害。”
我已联系 Roblox Corporation 寻求对这一事件的评论，如果收到回复，我将更新这篇报道。

items.title: 迄今为止我最喜欢的 2026 年原声带是今年最受欢迎的热门歌曲之一
items.summary: 澳大利亚二人组 aksfx 创造了一些真正特别的东西。
items.titleEn: My favourite soundtrack of 2026 so far is tucked in one of this year's biggest sleeper hits

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WcCZiWMVteuU25phgoBuD8.png
欢迎来到 Critical Hit，在这里我（或 PC Gamer 团队的其他人）庆祝并感叹视频游戏音乐、音频设计以及我们最喜欢的游戏让我们耳朵发麻的方式。
自从上个月我和六个朋友一起完成了 Big Walk 的游戏以来，我一直无法停止思考 Big Walk。我原本以为这是一款相对不错、快速有趣的合作游戏，但它却变成了我玩过​​的最有思想的电子游戏之一，也是我 2026 年迄今为止最喜欢的游戏。我什至无法开始解释 House House 开发商在创造一种极其特别、不可复制的体验方面所做的出色工作，这让我和我的朋友们在我们推出积分后的几周内继续谈论它。
虽然它的独特之处很大程度上在于它的谜题（以及其间的所有小时刻），但我爱上的最重要的事情之一是它的音乐。这是游戏的一个令人惊讶的零星方面——《Big Walk》没有随处陪伴你的配乐，你可以在一段真正的时间里完全听不到任何音乐。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tFPmN84eqUQxutaun7NTMn.jpg
但在它展现自己的世界的小角落里，让它打破寂静，会让你与它度过的时光感觉更加特别。澳大利亚二人组 aksfx 遍布近 30 首曲目，演奏着这些令人愉悦的空灵、脉动的节拍和跳跃的声音，听起来在纸面上应该有点令人不安，但执行却带来了这种令人愉快的探索和空灵的感觉。
Big Walk 的大量音乐分散在各个广播电台中，您必须去寻找它们，或者只是在与朋友一起探索和拍摄时偶然发现的。这些是游戏中我最喜欢的一些位置 - 广播电台提供完全身临其境的空间音频体验，因为每个广播电台都被扬声器包围，让你真正听到每个组件。
它们不仅是晒太阳的休息时刻，而且是与朋友一起度过可爱时刻的完美背景。在太阳升起的时候偶然看到一个广播电台，花一秒钟的时间观看它的发生，音符在你周围微妙地回响，感觉就像是生活片段动画的倒数第二集，让你大哭起来。
如果您不喜欢安静，您甚至可以随身携带这些音乐。 Big Walk 可让您将收音机绑在某人的背包上，将它们变成步行音箱/音频信标。对于 House House 来说，这是一个可爱的小选择——我很高兴随身携带一台这样的收音机几个小时，当我们最终把它存放起来时，我实际上感到有点悲伤。
但对我来说，aksfx 的代表作来自 Big Walk 的主题本身。这是你启动游戏时听到的第一件事——跳跃的声音在你第一次冒险进入大厅之前就唤起了这种奇怪的怀旧感。当你在 10 个小时左右的时间里完成制作时呢？它的打击力更大，每次我听它时都会让我流泪。
它增加了整体体验的舒适感，以及只需几声声音就可以让自来水厂运转的事实？嗯，这就是电子游戏音乐的意义所在，不是吗？让我们感受到事物，无论是在当下，还是由于它带来的记忆而脱离其原始背景。
喜欢 Big Walk 的理由有很多，而它的音乐无疑是我最喜欢的理由之一。就像游戏的概念、谜题和三点小玩家一样，游戏的配乐乍一看可能很简单，但它的执行带来了我意想不到的深度。

items.title: 我对带有飞行功能的舒适游戏情有独钟，这是我最喜欢的 4 款游戏
items.summary: 让那里有飞行！
items.titleEn: I've got a soft spot for cozy games with flying in them and these are my 4 favorites

content.v: 我游说让《Promise Mascot Agency》成为 2025 年年度游戏奖中的最佳舒适游戏，这意味着我（检查日历）本周将其添加到我的最佳舒适游戏列表中只是有点晚了。我喜欢它愚蠢的故事和开放世界的探索，并开始思考在悬崖边全油门并按下按钮长出翅膀，这样我就可以在加苏町岛周围和平地翱翔是多么有趣。
它甚至不是现在名单上唯一一款带有飞行功能的游戏。事实上，它是十个列表中的第三个。我想我对在舒适的游戏中飞行非常情有独钟。
有多少舒适的游戏玩家，就有多少“舒适的游戏”定义，但自由是一个非常常见的元素。在模拟生活中可以自由构建，在益智游戏中可以不受时间限制。除了完全自由的探索之外，飞行是什么？
自《荒野之息》以来，我们一直沉迷于带有滑翔机的开放世界游戏，但具有适当飞行功能的游戏甚至更好。在 Promise Mascot Agency 中，我可以敲击我的轻型卡车的助推器，将其车头向上推以获得高度，然后转弯第二次飞越下面的乡村。这是最开放的开放世界，也是我探索过的最自由的世界。
您最喜欢哪些带有飞行功能的舒适游戏？如果他们真的在飞行而不是滑翔，则会获得奖励积分。这是我的：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Gyipu3DJmsm4U4muG3Vy6o.jpg
承诺吉祥物机构
一旦你升级了带有翅膀的轻型卡车，你就势不可挡。这东西注定会被猛击并撞到你发现的每一个障碍物上，当你可以将它从之字形山路上发射到优雅的俯冲直接落在你正在寻找的收藏品上时，这一点就更加真实了。纯粹的喜悦。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/g9a23Dz5zY3LYVVn45WiBE.jpg
旅程
这是“舒适游戏”时代之前的经典游戏，它的重点是随着你在简短而感人的故事中前进，增加你的飞行距离。这一结局是飞行乐趣最纯粹的升华。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uPH79SKK3dxEieYxwP2VBg.jpg
天空：光之子
同样由制作《Journey》的工作室制作，它也有类似的飞行控制和距离升级，但它是一个微型 MMO，有大量的谜题和探索，我喜欢每隔几个月就回去玩一次。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/e4fdvt2imKPUFvWgNasdSa.jpg
短途远足
从技术上讲，这是滑翔的，因为我认为你无法获得高度，但探索美丽的洛菲岛寻找秘密区域正是飞行如此有趣的原因。

items.summary: 我扔掉了整个维京人并从头开始。我还没有厌倦它。
items.titleEn: After more than 400 hours of Valheim in early access, I love the journey from naked adventurer to godly Viking now more than ever

content.v: 欢迎来到 Play This Right Now，这是我们每周通讯的网站版本，我们在其中庆祝我们认为非常值得一试的新游戏、更新或 DLC。如果您想将我们对每周四推出的新视频游戏的想法直接发送到您的收件箱，您可以通过链接订阅时事通讯。
我又开始说废话了，我说的废话是指在《英灵神殿》中又度过愉快的 100 个小时——这是一款维京主题的生存制作游戏，是我在 Steam 上玩得最多的五款游戏之一。随着 1.0 及其新生物群系“深北地区”的推出，现在是召集朋友并返回古老的海上堡垒和沼泽城堡的最佳时机。奥丁的炼狱发生了很多变化。
或者更好的是，忘记旧世界并重新开始。当然，《深北之地》的终局是其最大的吸引力，但从头到尾，《英灵神殿》通过 Boss 重做、UI 的小调整以及一些新的过场动画，为世界构建提供了更好的体验。你无法通过启动旧的保存来很好地了解全局，在只带着一根木棍和破烂的皮革腰带潜入瓦尔海姆 1.0 后，我可以自信地说我一点也不后悔。
也许部分原因是跳过了去年的《战争召唤》更新——铁门在该补丁中戏剧性地重新设计了杀死瓦尔海姆巨神所获得的增益——但现在我很高兴我等待了。当我的《Valheim》总游戏时间迅速接近 500 小时时，我不禁对一些小改动和新物品让游戏进入终局的感觉印象深刻。
当我进入瓦尔海姆舒适的草地起始区时，其中一些变化就很明显，我保证任何像我这样的生存制作、基地建设威胁都会像我看到铁门重新设计的建筑用户界面一样兴奋。我不再需要无休止地滚动浏览大量的家具、墙壁和装饰，而是最终可以搜索并喜爱单个作品作为快捷方式，或者创建专用于我的常用工具的整个类别。这是多年来我第一次在没有大量生活质量建筑模组的情况下享受《英灵神殿》。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vhvsnMJB5cMxo2iBUgBrtM.jpg
我已经为每个区域制作了特定于生物群落的建筑集合，甚至还有简化版本，以便在紧急情况下快速访问。我们都因与我们无法应对的涪陵人打架而感到内疚，但我喜欢在他们身上拉上《堡垒之夜》。顺便说一句，这是在我周围建造一个盒子并呼救的代码。 《堡垒之夜》不就是这样运作的吗？
初次接触维京人或像我这样的老玩家也会欣赏《瓦尔海姆》从游戏早期的草地到灰烬之地末日地狱景象的平稳过渡。有了它的所有部分，你不需要深入维基百科或一群经验丰富的朋友来弄清楚冒险的下一步。
有一条通往 Valheim 的更清晰的大局路径，我们以前没有，我终于放心地推荐它作为一个版本完整的构建，没有所有早期访问的警告。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jszfE9hQx6EzdZpBX57RzM.jpg
老板对去年的重做特别配合，并在 1.0 的过场动画中添加了面包屑指示。我不会为你剧透整个事情，但从历史上看，瓦尔海姆在教维京人如何玩耍方面并没有做得最好。我的意思是，它仍然没有把它的秘密放在银盘上，但是当你得到一个关于下一步该去哪里的模糊提示以及一系列都感觉可行的老板增益时，这会更有趣。在我那个时代，我们有七个 Boss 爱好者，其中只有一个（或者两个）觉得可行。
铁门还大声而清晰地听到我们关于吝啬的存储空间以及在迷雾之地雾蒙蒙的大理石悬崖上航行的感觉是多么痛苦。深北更新配备了可升级的口袋空间和一个漂亮的抓钩，可以安全地穿越瓦尔海姆最敌对的区域之一——至少我是这么被告知的。您可能会惊讶地发现，我主要使用这些升级来容纳更多装饰品，并在更高的建筑项目之间弹射我的维京人。迷雾之地发生的事情不关我的事。
请注意，这都是在您到达北方深处之前的事情。 《瓦尔海姆》的最后一章中仍然隐藏着许多秘密，但仅通过其早期访问版本来记住这一点的旅程将是一种耻辱。因此，无论您是第一次玩还是经验丰富的维京人，我投票你们都以相同的方式开始：在草地上赤身裸体，挥舞着一根棍子。
